makaleler.baslik: NCCN Guidelines® Insights: Colon Cancer, Version 3.2026.
makaleler.baslik_tr: NCCN Kolon Kanseri Kılavuzu Güncellemeleri: Sürüm 3.2026
makaleler.kisa_ozet: NCCN Kolon Kanseri Kılavuzu 3.2026 sürümü güncellemeleri sunulmuştur. Kılavuzda fluoropyrimidine toksisite riskini azaltmak için pre-treatment DPYD testi önerilmiş ve non-metastatik hastalıkta adjuvan tedavi önerileri güncellenmiştir. Ayrıca ileri evre hastalıktaki sistemik tedaviler BRAF V600E mutasyon durumuna göre yeniden düzenlenmiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Colorectal cancer is the fourth most frequently diagnosed cancer and the second leading cause of cancer death in the United States. Treatment of localized disease usually includes surgery, sometimes followed by adjuvant systemic therapy, while advanced or metastatic disease is often treated with multiple lines of systemic therapy, based on biomarker status. These NCCN Guidelines Insights detail recent updates to the NCCN Guidelines for Colon Cancer, including recommendations for pretreatment DPYD testing to decrease the risk of severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity; updates to adjuvant therapy of nonmetastatic colon cancer based on the results of recent clinical trials; and a reorganization of the systemic therapies for advanced or metastatic disease based on biomarker status, highlighting changes to the treatment recommendations for BRAF V600E mutation-positive disease.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Journal of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network : JNCCN

makaleler.baslik: Quadratus lumborum versus transversus abdominis plane block for postoperative analgesia in laparoscopic colorectal surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Kolorektal Cerrahide Kuadratus Lumborum ve TAP Blok Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 4 RCT ve 419 hastayı içeren meta-analizde QL blok, TAP bloğa kıyasla 24 saatlik opioid kullanımını (MD -8,92 mg) ve istirahat/hareket ağrı skorlarını anlamlı düzeyde azaltmıştır. PONV (OR 0,54) ve baş dönmesi açısından anlamlı fark görülmemiştir. QL bloğun ERAS protokollerinde yararlı bir opioid azaltıcı seçenek olabileceği bildirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Effective pain management after surgery is crucial for recovery following laparoscopic colorectal resection in enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) programs. While the transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block is commonly used, it may not fully address visceral pain. The quadratus lumborum (QL) block might provide better coverage for both somatic and visceral pain due to its ability to spread to the thoracolumbar fascia and paravertebral space.
OBJECTIVES: This study aims to compare the clinical outcomes of QL versus TAP blocks in laparoscopic colorectal surgery. The main outcome was total opioid use within 24 h. Secondary outcomes included early pain scores, time until the first rescue analgesic was needed, postoperative nausea and vomiting (PONV), length of stay, surgical complications, and side effects related to the blocks.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic literature search using PubMed, Cochrane CENTRAL, Web of Science Core Collection, and Scopus from database inception to 27 July 2025 for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) comparing QL and TAP blocks. Two reviewers independently screened the studies, extracted data, and assessed quality using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. We calculated pooled estimates using a random-effects model and evaluated the reliability of the evidence on the basis of the grading of recommendations, assessment, development, and evaluation (GRADE) framework.
RESULTS: Four RCTs (n = 419) met the inclusion criteria. Compared with the TAP block, the QL block led to lower opioid use within 24 h (MD [mean difference] -8.92 mg morphine equivalents; 95% CI -11.57 to -6.28) and reduced pain scores both at rest MD -0.25 (-0.37 to -0.21) and during movement MD -0.40 [-0.52 to -0.29]. Operative time numerically favored the QL block, but the pooled difference was not statistically significant. The rates of PONV (OR 0.54; 95% CI 0.25-1.19) and dizziness (OR 0.60; 95% CI 0.22-1.63) were not significantly different between the two groups. The evidence was rated high for PONV and operative time, and moderate for opioid consumption, pain at rest, pain during movement, and dizziness, reflecting downgrades for imprecision and, for opioid consumption and pain during movement, substantial-to-high heterogeneity (I2 85% and 93%, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: In laparoscopic colorectal surgery, the QL block shows better opioid-sparing effects and lower pain scores at rest and during movement than the TAP block. Operative time numerically favored the QL block but did not differ significantly between groups. Importantly, it does not lead to more adverse effects. These findings suggest that the QL block may be a useful opioid-sparing option within ERAS-based perioperative care, although larger multicenter RCTs are needed before routine preference over the TAP block can be firmly recommended.

makaleler.baslik: Laser hemorrhoidoplasty vs. stapled hemorrhoidopexy: a meta-analysis of clinical outcomes with considerations in surgical anatomy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Hemoroidal Hastalıkta Lazer Hemoroidoplasti ile Stapler Hemoroidopeksi Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Stapler hemoroidopeksi (SH) ve lazer hemoroidoplastiyi (LH) karşılaştıran meta-analizde, LH daha kısa ameliyat süresi (25,9'a karşı 33,0 dk) sağlamıştır. SH grubunda üriner retansiyon (%7,7'ye karşı %3,0; OR 1,92) ve darlık (%4,5'e karşı %0; OR 9,74) oranları anlamlı derecede yüksek bulunurken, ağrı ve kanama benzer saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Hemorrhoidal disease is a common colorectal condition affecting millions. Recently, minimally invasive approaches have gained popularity for their faster recovery. However, current literature lacks a comprehensive comparison between these two methods. This systematic review and meta-analysis compares the efficacy and outcomes of stapled hemorrhoidopexy (SH) and laser hemorrhoidoplasty (LH).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Scopus identified studies comparing SH and LH. Patient cohorts were analyzed for recovery, perioperative outcomes, and complications. Meta-analysis was performed using R to calculate pooled Odds Ratios (OR) and Weighted Mean Differences (WMD).
RESULTS: LH demonstrated a significantly shorter mean operative time compared to SH (25.9 vs. 33.0 min; MD = 7.14). The stapled approach was associated with significantly higher rates of postoperative urinary retention (7.7% vs. 3.0%; OR = 1.92), stenosis (4.5% vs. 0%; OR = 9.74), and longer hospital stays (MD = 16.32). No significant differences were observed regarding estimated blood loss (MD = 2.49), return to normal activity, readmission, postoperative bleeding, or overall VAS pain scores at any time point (12 h, 24 h, 1 week, 2 weeks, and 3 months). Subgroup analyses indicated LH yielded significantly lower pain at 3 months in severe cases.
CONCLUSION: LH and SH showed no statistically significant differences across several reported short-term outcomes, including postoperative pain, bleeding, and time to return to normal activities. While LH was associated with shorter operative times, reduced hospital stays, and lower rates of urinary retention and stenosis in the available studies, these findings must be interpreted with caution. Crucially, the true comparative therapeutic efficacy of these techniques remains uncertain. Because relevant variables like symptom resolution, patient-reported outcomes, disease-specific functional outcomes were insufficiently assessed, while recurrence data are limited by heterogeneous and inadequately reported follow-up, this analysis permits conclusions regarding short-term perioperative recovery, but not robust conclusions regarding comparative long-term success and efficacy.

makaleler.baslik: Inferior mesenteric artery morphology and its branching variations: a meta-analysis of 9358 patients with implications for colorectal surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Inferior Mesenteric Artery Morfolojisi ve Dal Varyasyonları: 9358 Hastalık Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 9358 hastayı içeren 66 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, IMA en sık L3 vertebra seviyesinden (%60,35) köken almıştır. En yaygın anatomik varyasyon %38,42 ile 2 sigmoid artery varyasyonudur. Kolorektal cerrahide preoperative anatominin değerlendirilmesi için modifiye Yada ve McSweeney ölçeklerinin kullanımı önerilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The inferior mesenteric artery (IMA) is a crucial artery that supplies the colon and rectum. As colorectal cancer is most commonly localized in the descending and sigmoid colon, as well as in the rectum, detailed knowledge of the anatomy of the IMA is of utmost importance for oncological surgeons performing hemicolectomies.
METHODS: An extensive search of major databases was performed up to April 2026 for studies detailing the morphometry, anatomy, and variations of the IMA. The study strictly adhered to the PRISMA guidelines. Out of 143,884 initial records, 66 original studies met the inclusion criteria. A random effects model was applied in the statistical analyses, and heterogeneity was evaluated using Chi-squared and I-squared statistics.
RESULTS: The IMA most often originated at the L3 vertebral level (60.35%). The number of sigmoid arteries varied across the study groups, with 2 sigmoid arteries variant being the most common variant at 38.42%, followed by 3 sigmoid arteries variant at 31.30%. Across IMA branching pattern classification systems, the most prevalent anatomical variations were Type 1 in the modified Yada scale (47.39%), Type 1 in Latarjet scale (47.39%), Type 1B in McSweeney scale (45.51%), and Type B in modified Zebrowski scale (20.35%).
CONCLUSIONS: To standardize complex branching patterns, we propose supplementing the modified Yada scale with the exact number of sigmoid arteries for clinical practice, while recommending the McSweeney scale for prospective research. Surgeons must account for significant anatomical variability, as IMA originates at the L3 level in only 60.42% of cases, and the number of sigmoid arteries varies widely, most commonly presenting as two or three. Ultimately, accurate preoperative visualization and standardized IMA categorization are crucial for optimal surgical outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Sociobehavioral Comorbidities and Outcomes After Colectomy in a National United States Veteran Cohort.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolektomi Sonrası Sosyodavranışsal Komorbiditeler ve Postoperatif Komplikasyonlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Elektif kolektomi yapılan 38.188 gazi hastanın VASQIP çalışmasında, 90 günlük preoperative dönemde sosyodavranışsal komorbidite (SBC) bulunmasının 30 günlük postoperatif komplikasyon riskini artırdığı gösterilmiştir. Komplikasyon riski 1 SBC ile %16 (aOR 1,16), 4-6 SBC varlığında ise %80 (aOR 1,80, %95 CI: 1,32-2,36) artış göstermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the independent association between sociobehavioral comorbidities (SBCs) and complications after colectomies in a national Veteran cohort.
BACKGROUND: SBCs are determinants of health outcomes, and Veterans represent a high-vulnerability population. However, the relationship of SBCs with postoperative complications remains understudied, and current surgical risk models underestimate risk among patients with significant SBC burden.
METHODS: We conducted an observational study of Veterans undergoing elective colectomy included in the Veterans Affairs Surgical Quality Improvement Program (VASQIP). Structured data from the Veteran Health Administration Corporate Data Warehouse were used to identify 6 SBC phenotypes (mental health disorder, suicide risk, substance use, social isolation, housing instability, and food insecurity) across 3 preoperative ascertainment windows: ≤90 days, ≤365 days, and lifetime. The outcome was any 30-day VASQIP-defined postoperative complication. Multilevel logistic regression estimated associations between SBCs and complications.
RESULTS: Among 38,188 Veterans undergoing colectomy between 2009 and 2025, the median age was 66 years; 5% were female; 30% were non-white; and 48% had cancer. Mental health disorder, social isolation, or substance use were each associated with an 8%-40% increase in the odds of a complication across all ascertainment windows. Within the most proximal window, risk of complication increased as SBC burden increased: 16% increased odds with 1 SBC (aOR 1.16, 95% CI: 1.09-1.23) and 80% increased odds with 4-6 SBCs (aOR 1.80, 95% CI: 1.32-2.36).
CONCLUSIONS: In a national Veteran cohort, SBCs were associated with postoperative colectomy complications. The strongest associations were observed with SBCs ascertained within the 90-day window, and the odds increased in a dose-response relationship with increasing SBC burden.

tez.baslik: Üst rektum kanseri tedavisinde neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapinin ve doğrudan cerrahinin karşılaştırmalı analizi: Tek merkezli cerrahi sonuçları, onkolojik faydalar
tez.baslik_tr: Üst Rektum Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Kemoradyoterapi ve Doğrudan Cerrahinin Karşılaştırılması
tez.kisa_ozet: Üst rektum kanserli 102 hastanın retrospektif incelemesinde (73 neoadjuvan tedavi, 29 doğrudan cerrahi), gruplar arasında OS ve DFS açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır. TNM evresi (HR: 1,623, %95 GA: 1,045-2,520, p=0,031), T evresi (HR: 2,224) ve LVI varlığının (HR: 0,310, p=0,0204) DFS üzerinde anlamlı risk faktörleri olduğu görülmüştür.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Üst rektum kanserinde neoadjuvan tedavinin gerekliliği günümüzde halen tartışmalıdır. Bu çalışmada, üst rektum kanseri tanılı hastalarda neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası cerrahi uygulanan hastalar ile doğrudan cerrahi uygulanan hastaların onkolojik ve cerrahi sonuçlarının karşılaştırılması amaçlandı. Ayrıca neoadjuvan tedavinin genel sağkalım (OS), hastalıksız sağkalım (DFS), lokal nüks ve uzak metastaz üzerine etkilerinin değerlendirilmesi hedeflendi. Gereç ve Yöntem: Çalışmamız tek merkezli, retrospektif olarak planlanmıştır. Etik kurul onayı alındıktan sonra 18–80 yaş arası üst rektum kanseri tanılı toplam 102 hasta analiz edildi. Hastaların 73'üne neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapi veya kısa süreli radyoterapi uygulanırken, 29 hastaya doğrudan cerrahi tedavi uygulandı. Üst rektum, anal verge'den 10–15 cm arası olarak tanımlandı. Hastalara ait demografik veriler, tümör özellikleri (TNM evresi, lenfovasküler ve perinöral invazyon, MMR ve KRAS durumu), cerrahi veriler (operasyon türü, mezorektum kalitesi, cerrahi sınırlar, lenf nodu sayısı) ve postoperatif sonuçlar değerlendirildi. Bir yıllık takipte cerrahi komplikasyonlar (anastomoz kaçağı, darlık, ileus) kaydedildi. Uzun dönem sonuçlar olarak genel sağkalım, hastalıksız sağkalım, lokal nüks ve uzak metastaz analiz edildi. Bulgular: Neoadjuvan tedavi uygulanan ve uygulanmayan grupta genel sağkalım ve hastalıksız sağkalım arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı farka ulaşılamamıştır. Lokal nüks ve uzak metastaz oranları açısından gruplar arasında karşılaştırmalı analizler yapılmıştır. Postoperatif komplikasyonlar açısından her iki grup değerlendirilmiş olup anastomoz kaçağı, darlık ve ileus oranları incelenmiştir. Yapılan analizde, TNM evresi (HR: 1.623, %95 GA: 1.045 - 2.520, p = 0.031) ve T evresinin (HR: 2.224, %95 GA: 1.173 - 4.215, p = 0.014) DFS üzerinde istatistiksel olarak anlamlı risk faktörleri olduğu saptanmıştır. Ayrıca lenfovasküler invazyon (LVI) varlığının DFS üzerinde istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir etkisi olduğu saptanmıştır (HR: 0.310, %95 GA: 0.115 - 0.835, p = 0.0204). Sonuç: Üst rektum kanserinde neoadjuvan tedavinin sağkalım üzerine katkısı net olarak gösterilememiş olup, elde edilen bulgular neoadjuvan tedavinin seçilmiş hasta gruplarında fayda sağlayabileceğini düşündürmektedir. Üst rektum tümörlerinin biyolojik ve anatomik özellikleri göz önüne alındığında, tedavi yaklaşımının orta ve alt rektum kanserlerinden farklı olarak bireyselleştirilmesi gerektiği sonucuna varılmıştır. Bu konuda daha güçlü kanıtlar elde edilebilmesi için prospektif ve geniş serili çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır. Anahtar kelimeler: Rektal Neoplazm, Neoadjuvan Terapi, Kemoradyoterapi, Rektal Cerrahi, Sağkalım Analizi, Hastalıksız Sağkalım Analizi, Lokal Nüks.

makaleler.baslik: Primary Tumor Biology, Recurrence and Survival After Colorectal Liver Metastasis Resection: The BIO-CRLM Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal Karaciğer Metastazı Rezeksiyonu Sonrası Tümör Biyolojisinin Sağkalıma Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 44 merkezden 3162 hastanın incelendiği uluslararası kohort çalışmasında, birleşik tümör biyolojisi (lokasyon ve RAS/BRAF) nüksüz ve genel sağkalımla bağımsız ilişkili bulunmuştur (p<0,001). En yüksek mortalite riski BRAF mutasyonlu (HR 2,68) ve sağ-RAS mutasyonlu (HR 2,32) grupta izlenmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate whether integrated primary tumor biology, combining primary tumor location and RAS/BRAF status, defines recurrence phenotypes and survival trajectories after liver resection for colorectal liver metastases (CRLM).
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Selection for resection remains largely morphology-based, although tumor biology strongly influences post-hepatectomy outcomes. Primary tumor site and RAS/BRAF status are individually prognostic, but whether their integration identifies distinct post-resection trajectories is unclear.
METHODS: An international multicenter cohort of patients undergoing liver resection for CRLM between 2017 and 2023 was analyzed. Integrated biology was defined a priori as left-sided-wild-type, right-sided-wild-type, rectal-wild-type, left-sided-RAS-mutant, right-sided-RAS-mutant, rectal RAS-mutant, and BRAF-mutant disease. Primary outcomes were recurrence-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS). Secondary outcomes included early recurrence, disseminated first recurrence, and first recurrence phenotype.
RESULTS: Among 3162 patients from 44 centers, 2415 (76.4%) developed recurrence and 1342 (42.4%) died. Integrated biology was independently associated with both RFS and OS (global P<0.001 for both). Compared with left-WT tumors, the highest mortality risks were observed in BRAF-mutant disease [hazard ratio (HR): 2.68, 95% CI: 2.02-3.57, P<0.001] and right-RAS-mutant disease (HR: 2.32, 95% CI: 1.94-2.79, P<0.001). Integrated biology was also associated with early recurrence, disseminated first recurrence, and first recurrence phenotype. Rectal-RAS-mutant tumors had the strongest association with lung-only recurrence [relative risk ratio (RRR): 3.38, 95% CI: 2.22-5.13, P<0.001] and disseminated recurrence (RRR: 2.57, 95% CI: 1.86-3.55, P<0.001) relative to liver-only recurrence.
CONCLUSIONS: Integrated primary tumor biology identifies clinically distinct post-hepatectomy disease trajectories after CRLM resection. Combining primary tumor site with RAS/BRAF status may support preoperative counseling, surveillance planning, and trial stratification.

makaleler.baslik: Nationwide Trends in Perioperative Transfusion and Mortality by Hospital Surgical Volume in Biliary Tract Surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Safra Yolu Cerrahisinde Hastane Vaka Hacmi ve Transfüzyonun Mortaliteye Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 641.915 safra yolu cerrahisi hastasını inceleyen ulusal kohort çalışmasında, 30 günlük mortalite %0,5'ten %0,3'e gerilemiştir. Yüksek hacimli hastanelerde transfüzyon oranı daha yüksek olsa da (%4,8'e karşı %3,9), transfüzyon yapılan hastalarda mortalite oranı daha düşük bulunmuştur (%3,3'e karşı %4,4).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND/PURPOSE: This study evaluated associations of hospital surgical volume and perioperative transfusion with 30-day mortality in patients undergoing biliary tract surgery.
METHODS: This nationwide cohort study utilized data from the Korean National Health Insurance Service to identify 641 915 patients who underwent biliary tract surgery between 2012 and 2020. The primary outcome was 30-day mortality. Perioperative transfusion was classified into four levels, and hospitals were grouped into quartiles by surgical volume. Mortality trends were evaluated using linear regression and Cochran-Armitage tests.
RESULTS: The number of biliary tract surgeries increased over time, while the 30-day mortality rate declined from 0.5% to 0.3%. For all types of surgery, crude mortality increased across the transfusion-volume categories (p-trend < 0.0001). Compared with the lowest-volume hospitals, the highest-volume hospitals had higher transfusion rates (4.8% vs. 3.9%), but lower crude mortality rates among transfused patients (3.3% vs. 4.4%). Among transfused patients, volume-mortality patterns were more prominent in tertiary referral hospitals.
CONCLUSIONS: Hospital surgical volume and perioperative transfusion were associated with 30-day mortality following biliary tract surgery. The higher mortality observed among transfused patients may partly reflect differences in operative complexity and clinical severity. These findings support further evaluation of selective centralization.

makaleler.baslik: Survival differences between radiofrequency ablation and surgical resection for early hepatocellular carcinoma: a population-based comparative effectiveness study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Erken Evre Hepatosellüler Karsinomda RFA ile Cerrahi Rezeksiyonun Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: T1N0M0 (≤30 mm) HSK hastası 2763 vakayı kapsayan SEER analizinde cerrahi rezeksiyon RFA'ya kıyasla daha uzun sağkalım sağlamıştır (48. ayda ΔRMST -3,86 ay). Düzeltilmiş genel sağkalım farkları 24, 36 ve 48. aylarda sırasıyla %8,2, %13,5 ve %17,2 oranında cerrahi rezeksiyon lehine sonuçlanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Radiofrequency ablation (RFA) is less invasive than resection for early hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC); randomized trials in small tumors have not demonstrated a significant overall survival difference between the two treatments, whereas observational comparisons have suggested longer survival after resection.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: We analyzed data from 17 registries of the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) Program (2004-2023) for patients with T1N0M0 HCC ≤30 mm treated with RFA or resection. The primary effect measure was the restricted mean survival time difference (ΔRMST; RFA minus resection) at 24, 36, and 48 months.
RESULTS: Among 2763 patients (1287 resection; 1476 RFA), overlap-weighted ΔRMST was -0.58 (95% CI, -0.96 to -0.20), -1.88 (95% CI, -2.61 to -1.16), and -3.86 months (95% CI, -4.99 to -2.73) at 24, 36, and 48 months, respectively; corresponding adjusted overall survival differences were -8.2, -13.5, and -17.2 percentage points. In exploratory subgroup analyses, adjusted differences were smallest for tumors ≤20 mm and largest for tumors 31-50 mm.
CONCLUSION: Resection was associated with longer restricted survival than RFA in localized T1N0M0 HCC ≤30 mm; larger negative adjusted estimates were observed at successively longer analysis horizons. The smallest adjusted differences were observed for tumors ≤20 mm, although uncertainty increased at longer follow-up; these estimates may inform treatment discussions but do not establish equivalence. In exploratory analyses of tumors >30 mm, adjusted survival differences were larger and consistently favored resection.

makaleler.baslik: Predicting Emergency Conversion in Minimally Invasive Liver Resection: Clinical Implications of an AI-Based Preoperative Model.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Minimally Invasive Karaciğer Rezeksiyonunda Acil Konversiyonu Tahmin Eden Yapay Zekâ Modeli
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Hepatosellüler karsinom nedeniyle minimally invasive karaciğer rezeksiyonu yapılan 994 hastada acil konversiyonu tahmin eden Random Forest modeli geliştirilmiştir. Hastaların 128'inde (%12,9) acil konversiyon gelişmiştir. Model AUC 0,79 ile iyi ayrım sağlamış, yüksek risk gruplarında ameliyat süresi ve kanama anlamlı yüksek bulunmuştur (p<0,001).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Emergency conversion from minimally invasive liver resection (MILR) to open surgery, typically due to unexpected bleeding, is associated with poorer outcomes than elective conversion or completed MILR. However, prior studies rarely distinguished emergency from elective conversion and lacked integrated preoperative prediction tools. This study aimed to develop and validate an artificial intelligence (AI)-based preoperative model to predict emergency conversion.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed patients undergoing MILR for hepatocellular carcinoma between 2010 and 2023, including only those with emergency conversion due to unexpected bleeding. Thirteen preoperative variables were used to develop a Random Forest model with five-fold cross-validation. Model performance was assessed by the area under the ROC curve (AUC) and calibration. Patients were stratified into four risk groups, and operative and postoperative outcomes were compared.
RESULTS: Among 994 patients, 128 (12.9%) underwent emergency conversion. The model demonstrated good discrimination (AUC 0.79; 95% CI, 0.72-0.86). Observed conversion rates increased stepwise across risk groups (7.3%, 9.5%, 16.0%, and 37.7%). Higher risk groups were associated with longer operative times, greater blood loss, and prolonged hospital stays (all p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: This AI-based model enables preoperative risk stratification for emergency conversion during MILR and may support optimized patient selection and surgical planning.

makaleler.baslik: Surgical Management of Fibrolamellar Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Children Versus Adults.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Çocuk ve Erişkinlerde Fibrolamellar Hepatosellüler Karsinomun Cerrahi Yönetimi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: NCDB veritabanından fibrolamellar hepatosellüler karsinomlu 487 hasta (172 çocuk, 315 erişkin) incelenmiştir. Çocuklarda lenf nodu çıkarılması (%80,0 vs %58,6) ve pozitif cerrahi sınır (%15,1 vs %6,7) daha yüksek saptanmıştır. 5 yıllık OS çocuklarda %70,5, erişkinlerde %61,6 olup pozitif cerrahi sınır mortaliteyi artırmıştır (HR 3,16; %95 CI 2,15-4,64).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Fibrolamellar hepatocellular carcinoma (FL-HCC) is a rare liver malignancy affecting predominantly young patients, though management can differ between pediatric and adult populations. We evaluated age-related differences in treatment and overall survival (OS).
METHODS: Patients with FL-HCC diagnosed from 2004 to 2021 were identified in the National Cancer Database. Demographic, tumor, and treatment characteristics were compared, and OS was assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis.
RESULTS: Among 487 patients, 172 were children (< 18 years) and 315 were adults (≥ 18 years). Children more frequently underwent lymph node removal (80.0% vs 58.6%) and had higher positive-margin rates (15.1% vs 6.7%). Five-year OS was 70.5% in children versus 61.6% in adults. On multivariable analysis, adulthood (HR 1.38, 95% CI 1.00-1.89), metastasis at diagnosis (HR 3.47, 95% CI 2.39-5.02), and positive margins (HR 3.16, 95% CI 2.15-4.64) were associated with increased mortality.
CONCLUSIONS: Pediatric patients with FL-HCC had superior OS despite similar disease burden. Positive margins were strongly associated with mortality, supporting efforts to achieve R0 resection.

tez.baslik: Kolesistektomi sonrası safra yolu boyutlarındaki değişim
tez.baslik_tr: Kolesistektomi Sonrası Safra Yolu Boyutlarındaki Değişimlerin MRKP İle Değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: Kolesistektomi yapılan hastaların preoperatif ve postoperatif MRKP görüntüleri karşılaştırılmıştır. Kolesistektomi üzerinden 5 yıldan fazla geçen 153 hasta (%53,1) ile 5 yıldan az geçen 173 hasta (%46,9) karşılaştırıldığında koledok çapındaki artış 5 yıldan uzun süre geçen grupta anlamlı derecede fazla bulunmuştur (p=0,013).
tez.ozet: Amaç: Safra kesesi ameliyatı sonrası uzun dönemde safra yollarında fizyolojik dilatasyon geliştiğini gösteren az sayıda çalışma mevcuttur. Bu çalışmadaki amaç kolesistektomi sonrası uzun süre takip edilen hastaların safra yollarındaki fizyolojik değişimi safra yollarının boyutlarını ölçerek ortaya koymaktır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Genel cerrahi polikliniklerine başvuran hastaların safra kesesi ameliyatı öncesi çekilen MRKP ile güncel MRKP lerinde ana hepatik kanal, koledok ve intrahepatik safra yolları çapları milimetre cinsinden koronal kesitte anterior-posterior olacak şekilde en geniş yeri PACS veya e-nabız sistemi üzerinden ölçüldü. Bulgular: Hastalar kolesistektomi ameliyatı üzerinden geçen süre açısından değerlendirildiğinde 5 yıl ve daha fazla süre geçen 153 (%53.1), 5 yıldan daha az süre geçen 173 (%46.9) hasta mevcuttu. Kolesistektomi ameliyatı üzerinden 5 yıldan daha fazla süre geçen hastalar ile 5 yıldan daha az zaman geçen hastaların safra yolu çapındaki değişimler Mann-Whitney U testi ile karşılaştırıldığında koledok çapındaki değişim anlamlı bulundu (p=0.013). Sonuç: Bu çalışmada safra kesesi ameliyatının safra yolu boyutlarında etkili olabileceğini göstermiştir. Ameliyat öncesi ve sonrası safra yolu boyutları istatiksel olarak artmıştır. Popülasyon bazlı çalışmalar safra yolu dilatasyonunu değerlendirmede referans alınacak safra yolu boyutlarını değerlendirmek için yol gösterici olacaktır. Anahtar kelimeler: Koledok, koledok çapı, kolesistektomi, MRKP, ERKP, safra yolları, safra yolu dilatasyonu

makaleler.baslik: Kimura versus Warshaw technique for distal pancreatectomy: a meta-analysis and systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Distal Pankreatektomide Kimura ve Warshaw Tekniklerinin Karşılaştırılması: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Dalak koruyucu distal pankreatektomili 1312 hastayı kapsayan 6 çalışmalı meta-analizde, Kimura tekniği Warshaw tekniğine göre daha düşük yeniden yatış (OR 0,66; %95 CI 0,57-0,76; p=0,006) ve dalak enfarktüsü (OR 0,20; %95 CI 0,09-0,47; p=0,004) riski ile ilişkili bulunmuştur. Fistül ve komplikasyon oranları benzerdir.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Spleen-preserving distal pancreatectomy (SPDP) has emerged as the preferred approach for benign and low-grade malignant distal pancreas tumors. Two primary techniques exist: the Kimura technique (splenic vessel preserving) and the Warshaw technique (splenic vessel resection with short gastric vessel reliance). Despite widespread adoption, comparative evidence remains limited and methodologically inconsistent. The objective of this study is to systematically compare perioperative and clinical outcomes between Kimura and Warshaw techniques in SPDP, analyzing only studies with preoperative technique allocation to eliminate intraoperative selection bias. We hypothesize that the Kimura technique is associated with fewer postoperative adverse events compared with the Warshaw technique.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis following PROSPERO registration (CRD420251046633). PubMed, MEDLINE, Scopus, Google Scholar, and Web of Science were searched through November 2025 for English and Spanish studies published within 15 years. Inclusion criteria required preoperative technique selection based on imaging and tumor characteristics, with statistical comparison of outcomes. Studies employing "Kimura-first" or intraoperative decision protocols were excluded. Two reviewers independently extracted the data, with disagreements resolved by a third reviewer. Meta-analyses used random-effects models.
RESULTS: Six studies encompassing 1312 patients (839 Kimura, 473 Warshaw) met inclusion criteria. Compared to the Warshaw technique, the Kimura technique was associated with significantly lower odds of readmission (OR 0.66, 95% CI 0.57-0.76; P = 0.006) and splenic infarct (OR 0.20, 95% CI 0.09-0.47; P = 0.004). Overall complications, major complications, minor complications, reinterventions, and pancreatic fistulas showed no significant differences between techniques.
CONCLUSION: Although both the Kimura and Warshaw techniques demonstrated no significant difference in most of the postoperative outcomes for SPDP, the Kimura technique offers significantly lower odds of readmission and splenic infarction. Technique selection should be individualized based on patient anatomy, tumor characteristics, and surgeon or institutional expertise to optimize outcomes.

makaleler.baslik: Role of procalcitonin in guiding antibiotic therapy in acute pancreatitis: A randomised controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Akut Pankreatitte Antibiyotik Tedavisinde Prokalsitoninin Rolü: RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Akut pankreatitli 144 hastanın incelendiği tek merkezli RCT'de, prokalsitonin kılavuzluğunda antibiyotik tedavisi ile standart bakım arasında antibiyotik tüketimi açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır (DDD: 7'ye karşı 7; p=0,872). Mortalite (%5,6'ya karşı %8,2) ve enfekte nekroz oranları gruplar arasında benzerdir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Antibiotics are frequently overused in acute pancreatitis despite guideline recommendations against routine prophylactic therapy. Procalcitonin (PCT)-guided antibiotic stewardship may reduce unnecessary antibiotic exposure without compromising clinical outcomes. This study evaluated the efficacy of a PCT-guided algorithm in patients with acute pancreatitis.
METHODS: This prospective, single-centre, patient-blinded randomized controlled trial enrolled adults with acute pancreatitis. Patients were randomized (1:1) to receive either PCT-guided antibiotic therapy (PCT arm) or standard guideline-based management (non-PCT arm). Antibiotics in the intervention group were initiated and discontinued according to serial serum PCT measurements using a threshold of 1 ng/mL. The primary outcome was antibiotic usage measured as defined daily dose (DDD).
RESULTS: Of 152 randomized patients, 144 completed follow-up (73 non-PCT and 71 PCT). Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. Median antibiotic usage was similar between the non-PCT and PCT groups (DDD: 7 [5-10] vs. 7 [4-10]; p = 0.872). Fewer patients received antibiotics in the PCT arm (36.6% vs. 45.2%; p = 0.295). Median antibiotic duration was 7 versus 5 days (p = 0.178), while median hospital stay was 6 days in both groups (p = 0.178). Mortality (5.6% vs. 8.2%), infected necrotic collections (7.0% vs. 6.8%), and multidrug-resistant bacteremia (1.4% vs. 1.3%) were comparable. Among patients with mild pancreatitis, antibiotic use was lower with PCT guidance (7.9% vs. 18.4%; p = 0.098).
CONCLUSIONS: In this single-centre randomized trial, PCT-guided antibiotic therapy did not result in a statistically significant reduction in antibiotic consumption compared with standard care. Larger, appropriately powered multicentre trials, particularly among patients at risk of infected pancreatic necrosis, are required to determine whether PCT-guided therapy has a clinically meaningful role in antibiotic stewardship.

makaleler.baslik: Interventional management of postoperative pancreatic fistula: A systematic review and meta-analysis of literature.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Postoperatif Pankreatik Fistülün Girişimsel Yönetimi: Sistematik Derleme ve Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Pankreatikoduodenektomi geçiren 13882 hasta ve ISGPS evre B/C fistüllü 907 hastayı içeren 18 çalışmalı meta-analizde, harici wirsungostomi daha düşük endokrin yetmezlik (OR 0,07) ve hastane mortalitesi (OR 0,42) sağlamıştır. Ağır vakalarda tamamlayıcı pankreatektominin erken yapılması yatış süresini ve reintervensiyonu azaltmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) remains a formidable sequela that can cause significant morbidity and mortality. Although there are a great number of different management options, it is still not clear which therapeutic approach is the best. This study aimed to provide a synthesis of the peer-reviewed literature on the management of POPF and their respective clinical outcomes, and propose an algorithm for choice of management.
DATA SOURCES: A systematic search was performed on PubMed and Embase for all studies reporting clinical outcomes on the management of POPF from January 2000 to December 2024.
RESULTS: Eighteen studies evaluating a total of 13 882 patients with pancreaticoduodenectomy performed and 907 patients with International Study Group in Pancreatic Surgery (ISGPS) grade B or C POPF were included. Studies evaluated percutaneous catheter drainage, relaparotomy, pancreas-preserving procedure, surgical drainage, external wirsungostomy, duct occlusion, bridge stent, salvage pancreaticogastrostomy, and completion pancreatectomy as interventional strategies. Primary parameters of in-hospital mortality, length of hospital stay, rate of relaparotomy, and new-onset endocrine insufficiency were evaluated. External wirsungostomy was associated with less endocrine insufficiency [odds ratio (OR) = 0.07; 95% confidence interval (CI): 0.01-0.38] and hospital mortality (OR = 0.42; 95% CI: 0.12-1.46) compared to other interventions. Completion pancreatectomy carried significant morbidity associated with endocrine insufficiency, however if indicated in severe clinical conditions, early rather than late intervention leads to shorter hospital stay and lower reintervention rate.
CONCLUSIONS: A range of therapeutic options are available in the armamentarium to tackle the challenges of POPF, judicious selection based on clinical status is recommended.

makaleler.baslik: Postpancreatectomy Mortality (PPM) Following Minimally Invasive Pancreatic Surgery Is Mainly Driven by Pancreatectomy-Specific Complications: Application of the ISGPS Classification Through Root-Cause Analysis on a Nationwide Cohort.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Minimal İnvaziv Pankreas Cerrahisi Sonrası Mortalite Nedenlerinin İncelemesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: İtalyan IGoMIPS kayıt sistemindeki 3590 minimal invaziv pankreas cerrahisi hastasında postoperatif mortalite oranı %2,7 bulunmuştur. Ölümlerin yaklaşık 2/3'ü, teknik başarısızlıktan ziyade POPF ve PPH gibi pankreas cerrahisine özgü ardışık komplikasyonlar nedeniyle gerçekleşmiştir. İleri yaş ve ASA-PS ≥3 bağımsız öngördürücülerdir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Postpancreatectomy mortality (PPM) remains relatively unexplored after minimally invasive pancreatic surgery (MIPS). The International Study Group for Pancreatic Surgery (ISGPS) recently proposed a consensus definition and classification of PPM based on root-cause analysis. We aimed to assess the applicability of this classification and characterize mechanisms of PPM following MIPS.
METHODS: This study retrospectively analyzed consecutive patients undergoing MIPS enrolled in the Italian IGoMIPS registry (October 2019-July 2025). All PPM events were reviewed and attributed specific PPM types using structured root-cause analysis according to ISGPS criteria. Multivariable logistic regression identified predictors of PPM, and PPM type distributions were compared across procedures.
RESULTS: Out of 3590 patients, the PPM rate was 2.7%. Specifically, PPM occurred in 5.9% following minimally invasive pancreatoduodenectomy (MIPD), 0.8% following left pancreatectomy (MILP), and 4.8% following total pancreatectomy (MITP), while no PPM events occurred after parenchyma-sparing resections. Increased age and American Society of Anesthesiology Physical Status (ASA-PS) ≥3 independently predicted PPM. Root-cause analysis showed that most PPM followed cascades of multiple pancreatectomy-specific complications, predominantly postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) and postpancreatectomy hemorrhage (PPH). PPM 2 accounted for approximately two-thirds of deaths, particularly after MIPD and MITP, whereas PPM 1 and PPM 3 accounted for 13.3% and 15.3%, respectively.
CONCLUSIONS: Mortality after MIPS predominantly occurs after a cascade of pancreatectomy-specific complications rather than technical failure or isolated medical events. Centers performing MIPS should invest in strategies to mitigate POPF and PPH and minimize failure to rescue once they occur.

makaleler.baslik: Metro-Pancreas Stratifies Survival After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy and Surgery for Resectable Pancreatic Cancer.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreas Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Tedavi Sonrası Metro-Pancreas Sınıflandırmasının Prognoza Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan kemoterapi ve rezeksiyon uygulanan 623 pankreas adenokarsinomlu hastada, Metro-Pancreas evrelemesi tanı ve neoadjuvan sonrası dönemde prognozu stratifiye etmiştir. Neoadjuvan sonrası OUT grubundan IN grubuna geçen hastaların hastalıksız ve genel sağkalımı, baştan beri IN olan hastalarla benzer seyretmiştir (p=0,806 ve p=0,631).
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the prognostic utility of the Metro-Pancreas framework in resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAT) and resection.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Upfront surgery and NAT are options in anatomically resectable PDAC. Metro-Pancreas combines tumor size and CA 19-9 to stratify prognosis after upfront resection, but its applicability after NAT is unknown.
METHODS: We analyzed 623 patients with nonmetastatic, anatomically resectable PDAC who underwent NAT followed by resection from 5 institutions (2016-2024). Metro-Pancreas classification (IN/OUT) was determined by tumor size and CA19-9 levels. Treatment response followed NCCN 2026 definition based on radiologic and biochemical changes. Postoperative disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) were evaluated.
RESULTS: At diagnosis, 263 patients (42.2%) were Metro-Pancreas OUT and had shorter postoperative DFS (13.3 vs. 16.7 mo; P=0.003) and OS (29.5 vs. 34.8 mo; P=0.006) than Metro-Pancreas IN patients. After NAT, 71.9% of OUT patients were reclassified as IN, while 5.0% of initially IN patients became OUT. Among baseline OUT patients, 35.7% had significant response, 46.0% had minimal response, and 18.3% had progression. Prognostic separation was greater at Metro-Pancreas restaging (DFS: 7.7 vs. 17.3 mo; OS: 15.8 vs. 36.7 mo; both P=0.001). Patients reclassified from OUT to IN had postoperative DFS and OS comparable to those initially IN (P=0.806 and P=0.631, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing resection after NAT, Metro-Pancreas stratified prognosis at diagnosis and more effectively at restaging. Reclassification from OUT to IN was associated with favorable postoperative survival, supporting dynamic prognostic reassessment in the neoadjuvant setting.

tez.baslik: Serum trombopoietin düzeylerinin şiddetli akut biliyer pankreatitin erken belirlenmesinde biyobelirteç olarak kullanımı
tez.baslik_tr: Akut biliyer pankreatitte serum trombopoietin düzeylerinin hastalık şiddetini öngörme değeri
tez.kisa_ozet: 98 akut biliyer pankreatit hastası ve 48 sağlıklı kontrolün prospektif incelendiği çalışmada, serum TPO düzeyleri hastalarda anlamlı yüksek bulunmuştur (p<0,001). Ancak TPO düzeyleri ile hastalık şiddeti, Revize Atlanta, Balthazar derecesi veya yatış süresi arasında anlamlı korelasyon saptanmamış, şiddet öngörüsünde yetersiz kalmıştır.
tez.ozet: SERUM TROMBOPOİETİN DÜZEYLERİNİN ŞİDDETLİ AKUT BİLİYER PANKREATİTİN ERKEN BELİRLENMESİNDE BİYOBELİRTEÇ OLARAK KULLANIMI Amaç: Bu çalışmanın birincil amacı, serum trombopoietin (TPO) düzeylerinin akut biliyer pankreatitte hastalık şiddetini erken dönemde öngörmedeki değerini araştırmaktır. İkincil amaçlar, TPO'nun akut biliyer pankreatit hastalarını sağlıklı kontrollerden ayırmadaki tanısal performansını ve CRP ile karşılaştırmalı ayırt ediciliğini değerlendirmektir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Tek merkezli, prospektif ve kontrollü olarak planlanan çalışmaya 146 katılımcı dahil edildi. Bunlar 98 akut biliyer pankreatit hastası ve 48 sağlıklı kontrolden oluşmaktadır. Serum TPO düzeyleri ELISA yöntemiyle ölçüldü. Hastalık şiddeti Revize Atlanta sınıflaması, Balthazar sınıflaması ve bilgisayarlı tomografi şiddet indeksi ile değerlendirildi. TPO'nun şiddet öngörüsü ve tanısal performansı istatistik analizleriyle incelendi. Bulgular: TPO düzeyleri hafif akut pankreatit ile orta şiddetli/şiddetli akut pankreatit grupları arasında anlamlı farklılık göstermedi ve Revize Atlanta sınıflaması, Balthazar derecesi, CTSI ya da hastanede yatış süresi ile anlamlı korelasyon saptanmadı. Buna karşılık TPO düzeyi akut biliyer pankreatit grubunda kontrol grubuna göre anlamlı olarak daha yüksekti (p<0,001) ve akut biliyer pankreatit-kontrol ayrımında yüksek tanısal performans gösterdi. Sonuç: Çalışmamızda serum TPO düzeyinin akut biliyer pankreatit şiddetini erken dönemde öngören güvenilir bir prognostik belirteç olduğu gösterilememiştir. Bununla birlikte TPO, akut biliyer pankreatit hastalarını sağlıklı kontrollerden ayırmada umut veren bir aday biyobelirteç olarak değerlendirilebilir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Akut biliyer pankreatit, trombopoietin, Revize Atlanta sınıflaması, Balthazar sınıflaması

makaleler.baslik: Suture reinforcement versus no reinforcement in laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy: what do randomized trials show? A meta-analysis and trial sequential analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Sleeve Gastrektomide Zımba Hattı Sütür Güçlendirmesinin Etkisi: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2646 hastalık 14 RCT'yi içeren meta-analizde, LSG'de sütür güçlendirmesi kanamayı anlamlı azaltmıştır (RR 0,36; %95 CI 0,21-0,62). Kaçak oranı sütür grubunda %0,9, kontrol grubunda %2,3 saptanmış ancak yüksek yanlılık riskli çalışmalar çıkarıldığında anlamlılık kaybolmuştur (RR 0,48). Sütür ameliyat süresini 18,5 dk uzatmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Suture reinforcement (SR) of the staple line is widely used in laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG), but whether it prevents staple-line leak remains unresolved. We updated the randomized evidence comparing SR with no reinforcement (NR) and assessed its robustness for leak.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: PubMed, MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL were searched to 31 July 2026, with hand-searching of previous meta-analyses. Risk of bias was assessed for each outcome (RoB 2). Rare events were pooled with Peto odds ratios and Mantel-Haenszel risk ratios (RRs), and operative time as a mean difference (MD). Trial sequential analysis (TSA) and GRADE were applied.
RESULTS: Fourteen RCTs (2,646 patients; SR 1,410, NR 1,236) are included; seven are at high risk of bias. SR probably reduces postoperative bleeding (RR 0.36, 95% CI 0.21-0.62; 25 fewer per 1,000; moderate certainty), consistently across risk-of-bias subgroups. Leak occurs in 0.9% with SR and 2.3% with NR (RR 0.38, 95% CI 0.20-0.72), but the reduction is driven by small trials at high risk of bias and is not significant when these are excluded (RR 0.48, 95% CI 0.22-1.08). TSA shows that 21.4% of the required information has accrued, without crossing the monitoring boundary; certainty is very low. SR may increase operative time (MD + 18.5 min, 95% CI 13.3-23.7; low certainty).
CONCLUSIONS: Suture reinforcement probably reduces postoperative bleeding at the cost of a longer operation. Its effect on staple-line leak is very uncertain and rests on small trials at high risk of bias; adequately powered contemporary trials are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Evaluation of the Incidence of Gastroesophageal Reflux Following Sleeve Gastrectomy with and without Omentopexy: A Double-Blind Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: LSG'de Omentopeksinin Postoperatif Reflü İnsidansına Etkisi: RCT
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 290 morbid obez hastanın alındığı RCT'de, LSG ile omentopeksi yapılan grup (%20,0) ve tek başına LSG (%26,9) arasında 12. ayda yeni gelişen GERD açısından anlamlı fark bulunmamıştır (p=0,212). Sadece >50 kg veren alt grupta omentopeksi ile GERD oranı anlamlı şekilde düşük saptanmıştır (%9,4'e karşı %25,0; p=0,023).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is a common complication following laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (LSG), yet the role of omentopexy in mitigating postoperative reflux remains unclear. We conducted a double-blind, randomized controlled trial to compare the incidence of de novo GERD after LSG with and without omentopexy.
METHODS: Between 2023 and 2024, 290 adult patients (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m² with comorbidities or ≥ 40 kg/m²) without preexisting GERD or significant hiatal hernia were randomized (1:1) to LSG with omentopexy (Group A, n = 145) or LSG alone (Group B, n = 145). All procedures were standardized and performed by a single surgeon. Primary outcome was the incidence of new-onset GERD at 12 months, assessed by the validated Persian GERD-Q questionnaire. Secondary analyses explored associations with demographic and weight-loss parameters. Statistical comparisons employed χ² or Fisher's exact tests, with significance set at p < 0.05.
RESULTS: One year postoperatively, de novo GERD occurred in 20.0% of Group A versus 26.9% of Group B (p = 0.212). Mean weight loss trajectories were comparable, reaching ~ 44%TWL by month 12 in both arms. Subgroup analysis revealed that among patients losing > 50 kg, those in Group A exhibited a significantly lower GERD incidence compared to Group B (9.4% vs. 25.0%; p = 0.023). No significant differences emerged by age, sex, or endoscopic findings.
CONCLUSIONS: Omentopexy performed during LSG did not significantly reduce overall de novo GERD incidence at one year, although a trend toward benefit and a significant effect in patients with substantial weight loss were observed. Further large-scale trials incorporating objective reflux measurements are warranted to clarify the potential protective role of omental fixation in bariatric practice.

makaleler.baslik: Omentectomy Versus Omental Preservation During Gastrectomy for Gastric Cancer: Systematic Review and Reconstructed Individual Patient Data Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Gastrektomi Sırasında Omentektomi ile Omentumun Korunmasının Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 15 çalışma ve 5325 hastayı içeren meta-analizde, mide kanseri gastrektomisinde omentektomi ile omentum korunması arasında 60 ayda OS (-0,79 ay, %95 CI -2,13 ile 0,54) ve DFS (-2,12 ay, %95 CI -4,59 ile 0,35) farkı bulunmadı. Omentektomi daha yüksek kan kaybı (MD 42,9), komplikasyon (RR 1,17) ve hastanede kalış süresiyle (MD 0,49) ilişkiliydi.
makaleler.ozet: Background/Objectives: The oncological benefit of routine omentectomy (OmR) during curative gastrectomy for gastric cancer (GC) remains controversial. While omentectomy has traditionally been performed to reduce peritoneal dissemination, the greater omentum also possesses immunological functions that may protect against tumor implantation. This study evaluated the impact of OmR versus omental preservation (OmP) on long-term survival using reconstructed individual patient data (IPD) and restricted mean survival time difference (RMSTD) meta-analysis. Methods: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Comparative studies reporting Kaplan-Meier curves for overall survival (OS) and/or disease-free survival (DFS) after OmR versus OmP were included. IPD were reconstructed from published survival curves, and pooled RMSTD estimates were calculated using random-effects multivariate meta-analysis. Flexible hazard-based regression models assessed time-varying treatment effects. Secondary outcomes included postoperative morbidity and operative outcomes. Results: Fifteen studies involving 5325 patients were included, of whom 54% underwent OmR. At 60 months, no significant difference in OS was observed for OmR vs. OmP (-0.79 months, 95% CI -2.13 to 0.54). Similarly, DFS did not differ significantly (-2.12 months, 95% CI -4.59 to 0.35). Time-varying hazard analyses demonstrated no survival advantage for OmR throughout follow-up. OmR was associated with significantly higher intraoperative blood loss (MD 42.9), overall complications (RR 1.17), and longer hospital length of stay (MD 0.49). Retrieved lymph nodes, anastomotic leak, operative time, and 30-day mortality were comparable. Conclusions: In this study, routine omentectomy during gastrectomy for gastric cancer was not associated with improved OS or DFS compared with omental preservation. These findings question the need for routine omentectomy and suggest that omental preservation may represent a reasonable surgical strategy in selected patients, pending confirmation from prospective randomized trials.

makaleler.baslik: Pancreatic Exocrine Insufficiency Following Esophagectomy, Gastrectomy and Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review and Narrative Synthesis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Üst GİS ve Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Pankreas Ekzokrin Yetmezliği
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1397 hastayı kapsayan 17 çalışmanın derlemesinde, pankreas ekzokrin yetmezliği (PEI) sıklığı özofajektomi sonrası %3,2-%22,0, gastrektomi sonrası %25,0-%63,8, sleeve gastrektomi sonrası %4,2-%17,2 ve RYGB sonrası %8,3-%10,3 bulunmuştur. Enzim replasman tedavisinin semptomatik iyileşme sağladığı bildirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pancreatic exocrine insufficiency (PEI) is an increasingly recognised consequence of esophagogastric surgery; however, its prevalence, burden across different surgical procedures, and optimal approaches to diagnosis and management remain incompletely characterized. This review aims to systematically evaluate the prevalence, diagnosis, clinical manifestations, nutritional consequences and management of PEI following esophagogastric surgery in adults.
METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted according to Joanna Briggs Institute methodology and reported in accordance with PRISMA 2020. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Embase were searched from January 2011 to May 2026. Eligible studies reported PEI following esophagectomy, gastrectomy, or bariatric surgery. Owing to substantial clinical and methodological heterogeneity, findings were synthesized narratively by surgical group and procedure. Risk of bias was evaluated using JBI critical appraisal tools.
RESULTS: Seventeen studies comprising 1397 patients were included. Reported PEI prevalence varied substantially across surgical populations, ranging from 3.2% to 22.0% following esophagectomy, 25.0%-63.8% following gastrectomy, and 9.1%-32.6% in bariatric cohorts. Procedure-specific estimates varied considerably, with rates of 4.2%-17.2% following sleeve gastrectomy, 8.3%-10.3% following RYGB, 48.1% following distal RYGB and 75.0% following biliopancreatic diversion with duodenal switch. Fecal elastase-1 was the most frequently used diagnostic test, although diagnostic criteria and timing of assessment varied between studies. Gastrointestinal symptoms, weight loss, nutritional deficiencies and impaired quality of life were reported, while limited observational evidence suggested symptomatic improvement following pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy.
CONCLUSIONS: PEI is an under-recognised consequence of esophagectomy, gastrectomy and bariatric surgery, with reported prevalence varying substantially between procedures and studies. Greater clinical awareness and standardised approaches to diagnosis are required, alongside prospective studies to better define postoperative screening and management.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: This review was prospectively registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261369499).

makaleler.baslik: Open versus minimally invasive surgery for large type 3 and type 4 gastric cancer: multicentre retrospective national study at high-volume centres.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Büyük Evre Mide Kanserinde Açık ve Minimal İnvaziv Cerrahi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 1013 hastalık retrospektif ulusal çalışmada, büyük tip 3 ve 4 mide kanserinde minimal invaziv cerrahi (MIS) ile açık cerrahi karşılaştırılmıştır. IPW analizi sonrası MIS grubunda ameliyat süresi uzun (348'e karşı 282 dk), kan kaybı (36'ya karşı 300 ml) ve majör komplikasyonlar (%9,4'e karşı %16,1; p=0,003) daha düşük, sağkalım ise benzerdir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The impact of a minimally invasive approach for large type 3 and type 4 gastric cancers is unclear. This study evaluated the safety and feasibility of minimally invasive surgery (MIS) compared with open surgery for large type 3 and type 4 gastric cancer.
METHODS: This was a retrospective study of patients who underwent open surgery or MIS at 63 high-volume centres in Japan (2020-2022). Inverse probability was applied with weighting based on propensity score to compare the two approaches.
RESULTS: The eligibility criteria were met by 1013 patients. Open surgery was performed for 653 patients and MIS was performed for 360 patients (205 laparoscopic and 155 robotic approaches). After inverse probability weighting (IPW), the patient characteristics were well balanced. MIS resulted in a longer operating time (median 348 versus 282 min, P < 0.001) and less intraoperative blood loss (median 36 versus 300 ml, P < 0.001) than open surgery. MIS had lower incidences of Clavien-Dindo grade III or higher overall complications (9.4% versus 16.1%, P = 0.003), intra-abdominal infectious complications (5.1% versus 9.1%, P = 0.023), and pancreatic fistula (0.9% versus 2.9%, P = 0.038) than open surgery in IPW analysis. MIS showed survival outcomes comparable to those of open surgery (overall survival: HR 0.89 (95% c.i. 0.69 to 1.14); relapse-free survival: HR 0.83 (95% c.i. 0.67 to 1.03)).
CONCLUSION: MIS for large type 3 and type 4 gastric cancers may offer advantages in short-term outcomes, with equivalent long-term outcomes, compared with open surgery.

tez.baslik: Mide kanseri hastalarında neoadjuvan tedavi yanıtını öngörmede tümör dokusunda PD-L1 ekspresyonunun durumu
tez.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Tedavi Yanıtını Öngörmede PD-L1 Ekspresyonunun Rolü
tez.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan FLOT alan evre II-III mide kanserli 54 hastanın değerlendirildiği retrospektif çalışmada, iyi patolojik yanıt (MRS 0-1) veren grupta medyan PD-L1 CPS değeri anlamlı olarak daha düşük bulundu (3,00'a karşın 12,00; p=0,035). Cox analizinde CPS; DFS (HR 1,066; p=0,014) ve OS için bağımsız prognostik faktör saptandı.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, lokal ileri evre mide kanseri tanısıyla neoadjuvan FLOT kemoterapisi uygulanan hastalarda, tedavi öncesi endoskopik biyopsi materyallerinde immünohistokimyasal olarak değerlendirilen PD-L1 ekspresyonunun (CPS ve TPS skorları) neoadjuvan tedavi yanıtını ve sağkalımı öngörmedeki rolünün araştırılmasıdır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Ocak 2020 – Aralık 2024 tarihleri arasında SBÜ İstanbul Eğitim ve Araştırma Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniğinde, evre II-III mide adenokarsinomu tanısıyla neoadjuvan FLOT kemoterapisi aldıktan sonra küratif amaçla opere edilen 54 hasta retrospektif olarak çalışmaya dahil edildi. Neoadjuvan tedavi öncesi alınan endoskopik biyopsi materyallerinde DAKO 22C3 klonu ile PD-L1 immünohistokimyasal boyama yapılarak CPS ve TPS skorları hesaplandı. Ameliyat sonrası patoloji piyeslerinde Modifiye Ryan Tümör Regresyon Skoru (MRS) değerlendirildi. Hastalar iyi yanıt (MRS 0-1) ve kötü yanıt (MRS 2-3) olmak üzere iki gruba ayrıldı. İmmünohistokimyasal parametreler, preoperatif kan değerleri ve klinikopatolojik özellikler gruplar arasında karşılaştırıldı. Çok değişkenli analizlerde cox regresyon modelleri kullanıldı. Bulgular: Hastaların 43'ü (%79,6) erkek, 11'i (%20,4) kadın olup ortalama yaş 61,9 yıldı. Hastaların 17'si (%31,5) iyi yanıt (MRS 0-1), 37'si (%68,5) kötü yanıt (MRS 2-3) grubunda yer aldı. İyi yanıt grubunda medyan CPS değeri kötü yanıt grubuna kıyasla anlamlı düzeyde düşük saptandı (3,00'a karşın 12,00; p=0,035). TPS değerlerinde gruplar arasında anlamlı farklılık gözlenmedi (p=0,330). Cox regresyon analizinde CPS, hastalıksız sağkalım (HR: 1,066; p=0,014), tanıdan itibaren genel sağkalım (HR: 1,063; p=0,019) ve operasyondan itibaren genel sağkalım (HR: 1,052; p=0,047) üzerine bağımsız prognostik faktör olarak saptandı. Neoadjuvan tedavi öncesi ileri klinik evre (p=0,030) ve taşlı yüzük hücre histolojisi (p=0,016) kötü patolojik yanıtla anlamlı ilişki gösterdi. Nüks açısından pozitif lenf nodu sayısı (p=0,002), düşük VKİ (p=0,007) ve erkek cinsiyet (p=0,047) anlamlı risk faktörleri olarak belirlendi. Sonuç: Neoadjuvan FLOT kemoterapisi uygulanan lokal ileri evre mide kanseri hastalarında tedavi öncesi PD-L1 CPS değeri, patolojik yanıtla anlamlı ilişki gösteren ve sağkalım üzerine bağımsız bir prognostik faktördür. Düşük CPS değerleri iyi patolojik yanıtla, yüksek CPS değerleri kötü yanıt ve kötü prognozla ilişkilidir. Mide kanserinde neoadjuvan tedavi yanıtını öngörmede TPS'ye kıyasla CPS daha üstün bir parametredir. Bu bulguların çok merkezli prospektif çalışmalarla doğrulanması gerekmektedir.

makaleler.baslik: Long-term follow-up of postbariatric surgery mortality rates: a meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Postbariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Uzun Dönem Mortalite Oranları: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 449.957 hastayı kapsayan 34 çalışmalı meta-analizde, bariatrik cerrahi cerrahi dışı takibe göre uzun dönem mortaliteyi belirgin düşürmüştür. 12. yılda mortalite RYGB sonrası %4,34, kontrolde %7,11 bulunmuştur. Tip 2 diyabetlilerde 5 yıllık mortalite RYGB ile %2,29'a gerilemiştir (kontrolde %11,0).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Bariatric surgery effectively treats obesity and related co-morbidities, but the magnitude and durability of long-term mortality benefit compared with nonsurgical management remain poorly characterized.
OBJECTIVES: To synthesize the longest-term available mortality data comparing bariatric surgery with nonsurgical weight management in patients with obesity.
SETTING: Large-scale meta-analysis.
METHODS: A meta-analysis was conducted of studies published between 2000 and 2025 reporting mortality outcomes after sleeve gastrectomy or Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) compared with control cohorts with obesity. Survival at all available postoperative intervals was evaluated. Mixed-effects meta-regression assessed patient-specific modifiers of mortality, whereas random-effects meta-analyses evaluated timepoint-specific mortality and cause-of-death differences.
RESULTS: Thirty-four studies including 449,957 patients were analyzed. Early postoperative mortality was low across all cohorts. Over a longer follow-up, bariatric surgery was associated with lower cumulative mortality compared with nonsurgical controls. At 7 years, pooled mortality was 2.64% in controls, 1.64% following RYGB, and .76% following sleeve gastrectomy. At 12 years, mortality remained lower after RYGB (4.34%) compared with controls (7.11%). Among patients with type 2 diabetes, mortality at 5 years was substantially lower following RYGB compared with diabetic controls (2.29% versus 11.0%). Cause-of-death analysis demonstrated fewer cancer-related deaths after RYGB (odds ratio, .46; 95% confidence interval, .31-.70) but higher proportions of deaths due to accidents, substance abuse, and suicide.
CONCLUSIONS: Bariatric surgery is associated with durable reductions in long-term mortality compared with nonsurgical management of obesity, particularly among patients with type 2 diabetes, supporting its role as an important intervention for improving long-term survival in severe obesity.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Surgery for obesity and related diseases : official journal of the American Society for Bariatric Surgery

makaleler.baslik: Robotic-Assisted Versus Laparoscopic Revisional Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Revizyonel Robotik ve Laparoskopik Roux-en-Y Gastrik Bypass Karşılaştırması: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 27.341 hastayı içeren 5 retrospektif çalışmanın meta-analizinde, robotik revizyonel RYGB genel morbiditede (OR 0,65; %95 CI 0,43-1,00; p=0,049) ve kanama müdahalesinde (OR 0,55) azalma ile ilişkili bulunmuştur. Kaçak, yeniden ameliyat ve operasyon süresinde anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Robotic-assisted surgery has been increasingly adopted for complex revisional bariatric procedures, but whether it provides clinical advantages over conventional laparoscopy for revisional Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB) remains uncertain. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to provide an updated, procedure-specific synthesis of comparative evidence evaluating robotic-assisted versus laparoscopic revisional or conversional RYGB.
METHODS: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and CENTRAL from inception through August 2026 for comparative studies of adults undergoing robotic-assisted versus laparoscopic revisional or conversion RYGB. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed using odds ratios (ORs) for dichotomous outcomes and mean differences (MDs) for continuous outcomes, with 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Risk of bias and certainty of evidence were assessed using ROBINS-I and GRADE, respectively.
RESULTS: Five retrospective comparative studies comprising 27,341 patients were included. Robotic-assisted surgery was associated with lower odds of overall morbidity (OR 0.65, 95% CI 0.43-1.00; p = 0.049; I2 = 20.9%). No statistically significant differences were observed in reoperation (OR 0.61, 95% CI 0.22-1.68), leak (OR 0.48, 95% CI 0.11-2.00), hemorrhage/bleeding (OR 0.73, 95% CI 0.31-1.72), mortality (OR 0.62, 95% CI 0.04-8.73), length of stay (MD - 0.71 days, 95% CI - 1.66 to 0.24), or operative time (MD 13.43 min, 95% CI - 28.24 to 55.11). Robotic surgery was also associated with lower odds of intervention for bleeding (OR 0.55, 95% CI 0.34-0.88; I2 = 0%). Both significant results were sensitive to study composition in leave-one-out analyses. Certainty of evidence was very low for all outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: Robotic-assisted revisional or conversional RYGB was associated with lower odds of overall morbidity and of intervention for bleeding, with no significant differences in the remaining outcomes, including comparable operative time. Both findings were borderline and sensitive to study composition, and the very low certainty of evidence precludes conclusions of superiority.

makaleler.baslik: Weight, Fat Mass, and Lean Mass Changes After Bariatric Surgery and GLP-1-Based Therapy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahi ve GLP-1 Tedavisi Sonrası Vücut Kompozisyonu Değişimleri: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 5.616 katılımcılı 30 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, bariatrik cerrahi GLP-1 bazlı tedavilere kıyasla daha yüksek toplam kilo ve mutlak yağ kütlesi kaybı sağlamıştır. Büyük kilo kaybına paralel olarak mutlak kas kütlesi kaybı da bariatrik cerrahide daha yüksek izlenmiştir.
makaleler.ozet: Metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS) and GLP-1-based therapies both reduce weight, but their effects on body composition are not directly comparable across measurement methods. We systematically reviewed 31 studies; 30 studies comprising 5,616 participants were included in random-effects meta-analyses stratified by dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry or bioelectrical impedance analysis, with 12 months as the primary timepoint. In both modalities, MBS was associated with greater total weight and absolute fat-mass loss than GLP-1-based therapy. Greater absolute lean-mass loss accompanied the larger weight reduction, without establishing poorer proportional lean-mass preservation. Relative fat-mass change differed by modality, and heterogeneity was substantial. These indirect subgroup comparisons should not be interpreted as head-to-head treatment effects. Standardized comparative studies incorporating muscle strength and physical function are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Clinical Outcomes of Tirzepatide After Metabolic Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Tirzepatid Kullanımının Klinik Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Bariatrik cerrahi sonrası tirzepatid kullanımını inceleyen 5 gözlemsel çalışmanın derlemesinde, 6-12 aylık takipte ortalama %TBWL %12,0 ile %18,1 arasında değişmiştir. İlaç genel olarak iyi tolere edilmiş, ciddi yan etki bildirilmemiştir. Ancak kanıt düzeyi çok düşük olup daha büyük prospektif çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Suboptimal weight outcomes, including recurrent weight gain (RWG) and insufficient weight loss (IWL), remain important clinical challenges after metabolic bariatric surgery (MBS). Although tirzepatide has demonstrated substantial weight loss in nonsurgical populations, its role after MBS remains uncertain. This systematic review evaluated the clinical outcomes of tirzepatide initiated after MBS in adults.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review following PRISMA 2020 guidance. PubMed (MEDLINE), Embase, Web of Science Core Collection, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL) were searched from database inception through June 2026. Eligible studies included adults with prior MBS who received tirzepatide and reported weight, metabolic, or safety outcomes. Two reviewers independently screened studies and extracted data. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS).
RESULTS: Five observational studies met the inclusion criteria. Across studies, tirzepatide was associated with clinically meaningful weight loss after MBS. Mean percent total body weight loss (%TBWL) ranged from 12.0% to 18.1% at the last available follow-up (6-12 months), and a high proportion of patients achieved ≥5%, ≥10%, and ≥15% TBWL where reported. Absolute reductions in body weight and body mass index were observed in studies reporting these outcomes. One study reported reductions in both fat mass and fat-free mass following tirzepatide treatment. Limited data suggested modest changes in glycemic and lipid parameters. Available safety data suggested that tirzepatide appeared to be generally well tolerated, although safety data were limited and follow-up was short. Mild gastrointestinal adverse events were the most reported, and no serious treatment-related adverse events were reported. Risk of bias was rated as low in two studies and moderate in three, and the certainty of evidence for comparative weight-loss outcomes was rated as very low.
CONCLUSIONS: Current observational evidence suggests that tirzepatide may provide clinically meaningful additional weight loss after MBS; however, the available evidence remains limited and heterogeneous. Larger prospective comparative studies with longer follow-up are needed to confirm its efficacy, durability, safety, and comparative effectiveness in this population.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Diabetes, metabolic syndrome and obesity : targets and therapy

makaleler.baslik: Sex differences in weight loss and metabolic outcomes following bariatric surgery: the Dutch bariatric quality registry.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahi Sonrası Kilo Kaybı ve Metabolik Sonuçlarda Cinsiyet Farklılıkları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Hollanda kayıt sisteminden 14.190 hastanın retrospektif analizinde, kadınlar 1 yılda (%33,2'ye karşı %30,4) ve 5 yılda (%28,9'a karşı %25,9) daha fazla %TWL elde etmiştir (p<0,001). Erkeklerde ise hipertansiyon (%34,6) ve tip 2 diyabet (%27,7) iyileşme oranları daha yüksek bulunmuştur (p<0,01).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Sex-specific differences in body fat distribution and cardiometabolic health may contribute to distinct outcomes following metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS).
OBJECTIVES: To investigate sex-specific differences in weight loss and cardiometabolic outcomes following MBS.
SETTING: Nationwide bariatric quality registry, the Netherlands.
METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was conducted using data from the Dutch Audit for Treatment of Obesity. A total of 14,190 adult patients who underwent primary Roux-en-Y gastric bypass or sleeve gastrectomy between 2014 and 2018 were included. Primary outcomes were percentage of total weight loss (%TWL) and changes in hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemia, and obstructive sleep apnea syndrome. Recurrent weight gain was defined as regaining more than 30% of the weight lost since surgery at 5-year follow-up.
RESULTS: At baseline, men had a significantly higher prevalence of obesity-related co-morbidities than women. Women achieved greater relative weight loss at both 1 year (33.2% versus 30.4%, P < .001) and 5 years (28.9% versus 25.9%, P < .001). Men showed higher observed resolution rates for cardiometabolic complications, including hypertension (34.6% versus 23.7%) and type 2 diabetes (27.7% versus 13.6%; both P < .01). Recurrent weight gain at 5 years was 9.9% in men and 10.9% in women (P < .001). No statistically significant difference in %TWL between Roux-en-Y gastric bypass and sleeve gastrectomy was observed (P = .054).
CONCLUSIONS: Women achieved 2.8 percentage points greater %TWL than men after 1 year and 3.0 percentage points greater %TWL after 5 years. Men had higher observed resolution rates of obesity-related co-morbidities, although these findings should be interpreted in the context of their higher baseline metabolic disease burden.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Surgery for obesity and related diseases : official journal of the American Society for Bariatric Surgery

tez.baslik: Morbid obezite cerrahisi sonrası derin ven trombozu sıklığı ve proflaksi etkinliğinin incelenmesi: Retrospektif çalışma
tez.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomi Sonrası DVT Sıklığı ve Profilaksi Etkinliği
tez.kisa_ozet: LSG uygulanan 399 hastanın retrospektif analizinde ortalama Caprini skoru 3,67±0,86 bulunmuştur. Hiçbir hastada semptomatik DVT veya PE saptanmamıştır. Farmakolojik profilaksi alan grupta 1 hastada (%0,31) kanama ve 1 hastada (%0,31) kaçak gözlenmiştir. Erken mobilizasyonu içeren mekanik profilaksinin etkili olduğu gösterilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Günümüzde obezite tedavisinde yaşam tarzı değişiklikleri, ilaç tedavileri, endoskopik ve cerrahi yöntemler kullanılmaktadır. Cerrahi yöntemler hem fazla kiloların verilmesinde hem de obeziteye bağlı ek hastalıkların iyileşmesinde diğer tedavi yöntemlerine üstündür. Çalışmamızın amacı, cerrahi yöntemler içerisinde sıkça tercih edilen bir prosedür olan Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomi (LSG) yapılmış hastalarda Derin Ven Trombozu (DVT) proflaksisinin etkinliğini ve DVT sıklığının incelenmesidir. Yöntem: Ankara Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Anabilim Dalında Ocak 2020- Ocak 2025 tarihleri arasında LSG operasyonu uygulanan hastalar retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi ve hastaların venöz tromboz ile ilgili riskleri Caprini skoru ile belirlendi. Ayrıca bu hastaların eşlik eden hastalıkları incelenip demografik bilgileri kaydedildi. Hastalara uygulanan mekanik ve farmakolojik tromboz proflaksi yöntemleri ve etkinliği araştırıldı. Postoperatif dönemde DVT ve pulmoner emboli (PE) yanında uygulanan obezite cerrahisi ile ilgili kanama ve kaçak gibi komplikasyonları ortaya kondu. Bulgular: Çalışmamıza LSG operasyonu yapılan 406 hasta incelenmiştir. 18 yaşından küçük hastalar, operasyon öncesi DVT öyküsü olan 7 hasta çalışmadan çıkarılmış ve toplamda 399 hasta incelenmeye alınmıştır. Hastaların yaş ortalaması 37,66±11,55 yıl olup, Vücut Kitle İndeksi (VKİ) ortalaması ise 43,69±4,80 kg/m² olarak bulunmuştur. Bu hastaların Caprini Skoru ortalaması ise 3,67±0,86 olarak tespit edilmiştir. Çalışmada semptomatik veya klinik olarak tanı konulmuş DVT veya PE olgusu saptanmadı. Farmakolojik proflaksi verilen hastalarda 1 (%0,31) hastada kanama, 1 (%0,31) hastada ise stapler hattından kaçak izlendi. Farmakolojik proflaksi verilmeyen hastalarda ise kanama ve kaçak gibi komplikasyon izlenmedi. Sonuç: LSG sonrası DVT geçiren hasta saptanmamıştır. Bunun sonucunda hastalarda erken mobilizasyonu da içeren mekanik proflaksini̇n DVT önlenmesinde etkili olabileceği, seçilmiş yüksek riski hastalarda farmakolojik proflaksinin güvenle kullanılabileceği sonucuna ulaşılmıştır. Çalışmanın retrospektif olması, asemptomatik olgulara tarama yapılamaması çalışmanın başlıca sınırlılıkları arasındadır. Yapılacak çok merkezli ve prospektif çalışmalarla bu sonuçlar desteklenmelidir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Obezite, Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomi, Derin Ven Trombozu, Proflaksi
