makaleler.baslik: Intraoperative core competencies in oncoplastic breast surgery: Recommendations from the international breastics Working Group.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Onkoplastik Meme Cerrahisinde İntraoperatif Çekirdek Yeterlilikler Konsensus Önerileri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Uluslararası çalışma grubu, onkoplastik meme cerrahisinde teknik beceriler, doku yönetimi ve marjin değerlendirmesi dahil intraoperatif temel yeterlilikleri tanımlamıştır. Rehber, ameliyat sırasındaki hataları azaltmayı ve multidisipliner koordinasyonu güçlendirmeyi hedeflemektedir.
makaleler.ozet: The intraoperative phase of oncoplastic breast surgery (OPBS) transforms multidisciplinary preoperative planning into technical execution that determines oncologic safety, reconstructive success and immediate postoperative outcomes. This manuscript - the Intraoperative Curriculum in a three-part competency series - defines core intraoperative knowledge, technical skills and non-technical behaviors required to perform OPBS safely and effectively. Domains addressed include team communication and structured briefings, confirmation of consent and operative plan, marking and localization verification, positioning and draping, oncologic excision and specimen orientation, tissue handling and perfusion preservation, oncoplastic reconstructive techniques (volume displacement and replacement), implant and flap management, intraoperative margin assessment tools, hemostasis and blood management, asepsis and device management, intraoperative documentation, debriefing, and escalation/referral pathways for complex cases. Each domain provides core competencies, rationale, competency level/type (basic/intermediate/advanced; knowledge/skill/attitude), suggested learning environments and practical sign-off recommendations. The curriculum supports consistent intraoperative practice, reduces preventable errors, facilitates multidisciplinary coordination (especially with radiation oncology and pathology) and prepares trainees for supervised autonomy in OPBS.
makaleler.dergi_tam: European journal of surgical oncology : the journal of the European Society of Surgical Oncology and the British Association of Surgical Oncology

makaleler.baslik: Risk factors for non-sentinel lymph node metastasis in breast cancer: a meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme kanserinde non-sentinel lenf nodu metastazı risk faktörlerinin meta-analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13.304 hastayı içeren 37 çalışmalık meta-analizde, sentinel lenf nodu (SLN) pozitif meme kanserinde non-SLN metastazı risk faktörleri değerlendirilmiştir. SLN makrometastazı (OR 6,07), anormal preoperatif aksiller USG (OR 3,51) ve lenfovasküler invazyon (OR 2,68) en güçlü öngördürücüler olarak belirlenmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically evaluate risk factors associated with non-sentinel lymph node (NSLN) metastasis in patients with sentinel lymph node (SLN)-positive breast cancer.
METHODS: A comprehensive literature search was performed in PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library from database inception to November 12, 2025. Studies reporting multivariable analyses of risk factors for NSLN metastasis were included. Study quality was independently assessed by two reviewers using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS). Pooled odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using a random-effects model. Heterogeneity, sensitivity analyses, and publication bias were also evaluated. All statistical analyses were conducted using Stata version 15.0.
RESULTS: A total of 37 studies involving 13,304 patients were included. The meta-analysis demonstrated that SLN macrometastasis (OR = 6.07, 95% CI: 2.21-16.7), abnormal preoperative AUS findings (OR = 3.51, 95% CI: 2.25-5.47), extranodal extension of SLN (OR = 2.67, 95% CI: 2.07 -3.44), lymphovascular invasion (OR = 2.68, 95% CI: 2.18-3.29), perineural invasion (OR = 2.37, 95% CI: 1.18-4.76), tumor diameter > 2 cm (OR = 2.06, 95% CI: 1.52-2.78), clinical T stage ≥ T2 (OR = 2.44, 95% CI: 2.02-2.95), histologic grade ≥ 3 (OR = 1.76, 95% CI: 1.44-2.16), number of positive SLNs (OR = 2.32, 95% CI: 1.53-3.53), SLN positivity ratio ≥ 50% (OR = 2.17, 95% CI: 1.74-2.70), multifocality (OR = 2.68, 95% CI: 1.98-3.63), HER2 positivity (OR = 2.22, 95% CI: 1.63-3.01), and a high Ki-67 index (OR = 2.20, 95% CI: 1.13-4.25) were associated with an increased risk of NSLN metastasis.
CONCLUSION: SLN tumor burden, abnormal preoperative axillary ultrasound findings, tumor aggressiveness, and intrinsic biological characteristics (e.g., HER2 status and Ki-67 index) are key predictors of NSLN metastasis. Given the limitations in the quality and quantity of the included studies, further high-quality, large-scale prospective studies are warranted to validate these findings and provide more robust evidence for individualized axillary management in breast cancer.
SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO/, identifier CRD420261301905.

makaleler.baslik: Impact of multidisciplinary tumor meetings on clinical outcomes, treatment concordance, and guideline adherence in breast cancer: a systematic review with emphasis on older patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde Multidisipliner Konseylerin Yaşlı Hastalardaki Klinik Sonuçlara Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 62.134 hastayı kapsayan 45 çalışmanın derlemesinde, multidisipliner tümör konseylerinin meme kanserli yaşlı hastalarda 5 yıllık genel sağkalımı artırdığı (%56'ya karşı %71; p<0,001) saptanmıştır. Ancak yaşlılarda kılavuz uyumsuzluğu ve konseylerde geriatrik değerlendirme eksikliği dikkat çekmektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Despite international guidelines that include specific recommendations for older patients with breast cancer (BC), there is limited evidence regarding their implementation in multidisciplinary team meetings (MDTMs). This systematic review evaluates the influence of MDTMs on clinical outcomes and treatment decision-making in older patients with BC.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in PubMed Central. Eligible studies assessed the impact of MDTMs on survival, adherence to MDTM recommendations, treatment modifications following MDTM decisions, or guideline adherence. Age-specific outcomes were analysed where reported.
RESULTS: Of 474 identified studies, 45 (n = 62,134 BC patients) met the inclusion criteria. Eighteen studies (40%) reported age-specific outcomes for older patients, while 27 (60%) did not. Eleven studies (24%) evaluated the impact of MDTM presentation or treatment modification on survival or recurrence; of these, ten demonstrated improved outcomes. Only two studies assessed survival outcomes specifically in older patients (n = 8153), reporting improved five-year overall survival (56% pre-MDTM vs. 71% post-MDTM; P < 0.001) and reduced BC-specific mortality in patients aged ≥80 years (P = 0.001) and 65-79 years (P = 0.01). MDTM recommendations for older patients deviated from clinical guidelines in six studies, and adherence to MDTM recommendations was lower in older compared to younger patients in eight studies. Only two studies (4%) incorporated geriatric assessment (GA) prior to MDTM, one of which reported treatment de-escalation in 22% of cases. None evaluated quality-of-life outcomes.
CONCLUSION: Evidence supporting the effectiveness of MDTMs in older patients with BC remains limited, reflecting their underrepresentation in clinical studies and the infrequent integration of GA.

makaleler.baslik: Impact of rhomboid intercostal plane block on chronic pain incidence and acute pain scores after oncologic breast surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Onkolojik meme cerrahisinde romboid interkostal plan bloğunun kronik ağrıya etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 247 hastanın tamamladığı randomize controlled trial çalışmasında, preoperatif romboid interkostal plan bloğu (RIB) uygulanan grupta 3. ayda (%17'ye karşı %31; p=0,009) ve 6. ayda (%13'e karşı %30; p<0,001) kronik ağrı insidansı anlamlı düşük bulunmuştur. 24 saatlik opioid tüketimi de RIB grubunda daha azdır (p=0,01).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Persistent chronic pain after oncologic breast surgery remains a major clinical problem, affecting approximately 25-60% of patients and significantly impairing quality of life. Although the rhomboid intercostal plane block (RIB) has been shown to reduce acute postoperative pain, its role in preventing chronic postoperative pain remains inadequately investigated.
METHODS: This prospective, single-center, randomized, double-blind, controlled trial included 254 adult women undergoing oncologic breast surgery with or without lymph node dissection. Patients were randomized to receive either a pre-operative ultrasound-guided single-shot RIB using 30 mL of 0.25% bupivacaine or no regional block (control group). All patients received standardized multimodal systemic analgesia. The primary outcome was the incidence of chronic pain at 3 months postoperatively. Secondary outcomes included chronic pain at 6 months, Brief Pain Inventory-Short Form scores at 3 and 6 months, neuropathic pain assessed using the Douleur Neuropathique 4 questionnaire, acute postoperative pain scores, and 24-h postoperative opioid consumption.
RESULTS: Of the 254 randomized patients, 247 completed the study. Chronic pain incidence was significantly lower in the RIB group at 3 months (17% vs 31%; p = 0.009) and 6 months (13% vs 30%; p < 0.001), with reduced neuropathic pain at 6 months. The RIB group had lower 24-h opioid consumption than controls (p = 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: Pre-operative single-shot RIB significantly reduced chronic postoperative pain and opioid consumption following oncologic breast surgery, and may be considered as part of multimodal analgesia to decrease chronic pain incidence, neuropathic pain and improve acute postoperative pain control.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT06019325 registered August 17, 2023).

makaleler.baslik: Quality of Recovery After Primary Breast Cancer Surgery: A Randomized, Two-Centre, Triple-Blinded Trial Comparing Erector Spinae Plane Block and Intravenous Lidocaine Infusion Within a Multimodal Analgesia Framework.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Primer meme kanseri cerrahisinde erektör spina bloğu ve lidokain infüzyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Primer meme kanseri cerrahisi geçiren 80 hastalık iki merkezli RCT'de, erektör spina plan bloğu (ESPB) ve intraoperatif intravenöz lidokain infüzyonu (IVLI) karşılaştırılmıştır. 24. saatteki QoR15 derlenme skorlarında (137,7'ye karşı 136,3; p=0,61) ve ağrı skorlarında gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The erector spinae plane block (ESPB) is widely used for primary breast cancer surgery (BCS), though its clinical benefits within optimized multimodal analgesia pathways remain uncertain. Intravenous lidocaine infusion (IVLI) offers a simple, reproducible alternative with potential systemic analgesic effects. This randomized, tripleblinded, placebo controlled, twocentre trial compared the quality of recovery after ESPB versus IVLI for BCS.
METHODS: Eighty adult patients undergoing primary BCS, with or without axillary dissection, were randomized to receive either ultrasoundguided ESPB (n=40) or intraoperative IVLI (n=40), in addition to a standardized multimodal analgesic protocol. The primary outcome was quality of recovery (QoR15) score at 24 hours. Secondary outcomes included postoperative pain scores, opioid consumption, adverse events, and rescue analgesia requirements.
RESULTS: Both interventions produced excellent postoperative recovery, with 24hour QoR15 scores approaching preoperative baselines with no significant difference between groups (mean (SD) 24-hour QoR score; ESPB vs. IVLI group, 137.7(17.9) vs. 136.3(8.8), p=0.61). Pain burden and analgesic requirements over the first 24 hours were similarly low, and no ESPB or lidocainerelated adverse events were observed.
CONCLUSIONS: Within a standardized multimodal analgesic framework, postoperative recovery and analgesic outcomes did not differ significantly between IVLI and ESPB, suggesting that IVLI may offer a pragmatic alternative when regional anesthesia expertise is limited.

tez.baslik: İdiopatik granülomatöz mastit ve invaziv meme kanserinin ayırıcı tanısında sistemik immün-inflamasyon indeksi ve C-reaktif protein düzeylerinin tanısal performansı: retrospektif bir karşılaştırmalı analiz
tez.baslik_tr: İdiopatik granülomatöz mastit ve meme kanseri ayırıcı tanısında SII ve CRP
tez.kisa_ozet: 117 idiopatik granülomatöz mastit (İGM) ve 110 meme kanseri hastasının incelendiği çalışmada ayırıcı tanı parametreleri değerlendirilmiştir. CRP >9,9 mg/L eşik değeri %92,73 duyarlılık (AUC=0,920); SII >889,14 eşik değeri ise %83,64 duyarlılık ile (AUC=0,906) İGM lehine yüksek ayırt edicilik göstermiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmada hem klinik muayene hem de radyolojik görüntüleme aşamalarında invaziv meme kanseri (İMK) ile benzerlik gösterebilen idiyopatik granülomatöz mastit (İGM) olgularının ayırıcı tanısına odaklanılmıştır. Tanı sürecinde Sistemik İmmün-İnflamasyon İndeksi (SII) ve C-Reaktif Protein (CRP) seviyelerinin tanısal değerinin karşılaştırılması, bu iki parametrenin histopatolojik inceleme öncesinde ucuz ve objektif birer laboratuvar göstergesi olarak kullanılabilirliğinin araştırılması ve spesifik sınır (cut-off) değerlerinin belirlenmesi amaçlanmıştır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Araştırma, 2019 yılı ve sonrasında Ankara Bilkent Şehir Hastanesi'nde takip edilen hastaların verilerinin retrospektif analiziyle kurgulanmış, tanımlayıcı ve karşılaştırmalı bir klinik çalışmadır. İncelemeye, patolojik olarak İGM tanısı kesinleşmiş 117 hasta ile evre I–III (M0) düzeyinde, neoadjuvan tedavi geçmişi bulunmayan ve aksiller lenf tutulumu saptanmayan 110 İMK hastası (toplam 227 olgu) dahil edilmiştir. Uzak metastazı bulunanlar, eksik veriye sahip olanlar, eş zamanlı akut/kronik sistemik enfeksiyonu veya inflamatuvar hastalığı olanlar ile steroid/immünsüpresif ilaç kullananlar araştırma dışı bırakılmıştır. Hastaların tam kan sayımı verilerinden SII formülü (Nötrofil x Trombosit / Lenfosit) hesaplanmış; istatistiksel değerlendirmelerde Mann-Whitney U testi, Spearman korelasyon analizi, ROC eğrisi analizi ve çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon modelleri kullanılmıştır. Bulgular: İGM tanılı grubun yaş ortalaması (33,87±7,89), İMK grubuna (55,9 ±12,99) kıyasla istatistiksel açıdan belirgin derecede düşük bulunmuştur (p 889,14 eşik değerinin %83,64 duyarlılık ve %84,62 özgüllük (AUC=0,906) sağladığı; CRP için belirlenen >9,9 mg/L eşik değerinin ise %92,73 duyarlılık ve %85,47 özgüllük (AUC=0,920) ile İGM lehine en yüksek ayırt edici performansa sahip olduğu görülmüştür. Sonuç: İGM, fiziksel muayene ve radyolojik bulgularıyla kötü huylu tümörleri ileri düzeyde taklit edebilen inflamatuar bir patolojidir. Rutin laboratuvar tetkikleriyle kolayca elde edilebilen SII ve CRP, biyopsi öncesi dönemde bu iki patolojinin ayırt edilmesinde klinisyene önemli bir katkı sunabilir. Özellikle 9,9 mg/L üzerindeki CRP ve 889,14 üzerindeki SII değerleri, tanısal eğilimi meme kanserinden uzaklaştırarak güçlü bir şekilde İGM'yi işaret etmekte; bu sayede hastaları gereksiz invaziv girişimlerden, cerrahi süreçlerden ve buna bağlı psikolojik yükten koruma potansiyeli taşımaktadır. Anahtar Kelimeler: İdiyopatik granülomatöz mastit, Meme kanseri, Sistemik immün-inflamasyon indeksi (SII), C-reaktif protein (CRP), Ayırıcı tanı.

makaleler.baslik: Mesh fixation versus non-fixation in laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair: absolute burden and clinical relevance of chronic pain - a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik kasık fıtığı onarımında greft tespitine karşı tespitsizlik meta-analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 3.702 hastayı içeren 28 RCT'nin meta-analizinde, greft tespiti yapılmaması TAPP ve TEP tekniklerinde erken ameliyat sonrası ağrıyı azaltmıştır. TAPP'ta tespitle kronik ağrı riski yüksek bulunsa da (RR 5,9; %95 CI 1,6-21,7) 6 ay ve sonrası takiplerde fark saptanmamıştır. Tekrarlama, seroma ve SSI açısından fark bulunmamıştır (p>0,05).
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Mesh fixation has long been standard practice in laparoscopic inguinal hernia repair (L-IHR), but its necessity remains debated, as fixation devices may contribute to chronic groin pain and increased costs without a clear benefit in mesh stability. While non-fixation is now widely regarded as a safe default, the absolute magnitude and clinical relevance of the pain attributable to fixation remain poorly quantified. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to compare mesh fixation versus non-fixation in adults undergoing L-IHR and to quantify the absolute burden of chronic pain associated with fixation.
METHODS: A comprehensive online search was conducted across databases (PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Cochrane Library) from inception to March 31, 2026. Additionally, a citation reference search was performed to identify further relevant studies. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) exclusively comparing mesh fixation versus non-fixation in adults undergoing L-IHR were included, with no language restrictions. The primary outcomes were chronic pain, postoperative pain, surgical site infection (SSI), seroma formation, and hernia recurrence. Secondary outcomes included time to resume normal activities, length of stay (LOS), operative time (OT), and procedural cost. Meta-analysis was performed using Review Manager (RevMan) version 5.4, and heterogeneity was assessed using I² statistics. Certainty of evidence was assessed with the GRADE approach.
RESULTS: A total of 4,826 records were identified, and 28 RCTs comprising 3,702 patients were included, 16 evaluating the totally extraperitoneal (TEP) and 12 the transabdominal preperitoneal (TAPP) technique. Postoperative pain consistently favored non-fixation at all timepoints in both techniques (TEP: SMD, 0.3 to 0.8; TAPP: SMD, 0.8 to 2.3; all P ≤ 0.04). Chronic pain differed by technique: fixation showed no significant excess in TEP (RR, 1.3; 95% CI, 0.9 to 1.9) but a higher incidence in TAPP (RR, 5.9; 95% CI, 1.6 to 21.7; NNTH, 9); this TAPP estimate was not robust to the exclusion of one or two trials, and no significant excess was observed in trials that assessed chronic pain at six months or later (TEP: RR, 1.4; 95% CI, 0.7 to 2.9; TAPP: RR, 2.0; 95% CI, 0.4 to 9.8). When six-month pain scores were re-expressed on a 0-10 scale, the pooled difference was approximately 0.6 points (95% CI, 0.4 to 0.8), below thresholds of clinical importance proposed for acute and chronic pain, although no threshold has been validated for chronic post-herniorrhaphy pain. No difference was observed in surgical site infection (SSI), seroma formation, or hernia recurrence (all P > 0.05). Return to normal activities favored non-fixation in TAPP (MD, 2.2 days; P < 0.00001), with a borderline effect in TEP that did not reach significance (MD, 0.8 days; P = 0.05). Operative time (OT) was longer with fixation by approximately 4.3 min, with no difference between techniques (MD, 4.3 min; P < 0.0001). Length of stay (LOS) favored non-fixation in TAPP (MD, 0.6 days; P < 0.00001) but not in TEP. Total procedural costs were higher with fixation in all six trials reporting them, with unweighted mean differences of US$542 (range, 303 to 852) in TEP and US$591 (range, 503 to 704) in TAPP, derived from heterogeneous health-care settings. Certainty of evidence ranged from very low to moderate.
CONCLUSION: In L-IHR, mechanical fixation was associated with greater postoperative pain than non-fixation, with a small pooled difference at six months, while SSI, seroma, and hernia recurrence showed no evidence of a difference between groups, although the estimates for SSI and recurrence were imprecise. An excess of chronic pain with fixation was observed in TAPP but not in TEP; this signal was not robust in sensitivity analyses, and no significant excess was observed in trials that assessed chronic pain at six months or later. Fixation also prolonged OT by a few minutes and added procedural cost, while non-fixation conferred faster recovery and shorter stay in TAPP. Non-fixation remains the approach recommended by current guidelines for most hernia types, with fixation reserved for large medial defects; these data quantify, rather than justify, the pain, time, and cost associated with departing from that default. The certainty of the evidence ranged from very low to moderate.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: PROSPERO CRD420261419247.

makaleler.baslik: Comparison of the efficacy of self-gripping mesh and sutured mesh in lichtenstein inguinal hernia repair: a meta-analysis and GRADE assessment.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Lichtenstein onarımında kendinden yapışkanlı ve dikişli greftlerin karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Lichtenstein kasık fıtığı onarımında kendinden yapışkanlı ve dikişli greftleri karşılaştıran 19 RCT'nin meta-analizinde (4.301 hasta), kendinden yapışkanlı greft ile ameliyat süresi (MD -6,99 dk; p<0,00001) ve 24 saatlik ağrı skoru (MD -1,51; p=0,04) anlamlı derecede düşük bulunmuştur. Kronik ağrı ve nüks oranlarında fark saptanmamıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Lichtenstein inguinal hernia repair is a common surgical procedure. Self-gripping mesh, a novel mesh that does not require suturing, has emerged as a potential alternative to traditional sutured mesh. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy differences between self-gripping and sutured meshes in this surgery through a meta-analysis.
METHODS: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) that met the inclusion criteria were identified through database searches in PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and Web of Science. Meta-analysis was performed using Cochrane RevMan 5.4 software, and the quality of evidence was assessed using the Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation (GRADE) approach.
RESULTS: Nineteen RCTs involving 4301 patients were included. The meta-analysis showed that compared to the sutured mesh group, the self-gripping mesh group had significantly shorter surgical time [mean difference (MD) = -6.99 min, 95% confidence interval (CI) (-8.73, -5.25), P < 0.00001], and a lower postoperative 24-hour pain score [MD = -1.51, 95% CI (-2.95, -0.07), P = 0.04]. No significant differences were observed between the two groups regarding length of hospital stay, 1-year postoperative chronic pain incidence, 2-year postoperative chronic pain incidence, seroma incidence, hematoma incidence, and recurrence rate. No significant publication bias was found. GRADE assessment showed that the quality of evidence for surgical time, length of hospital stay, and 24-hour postoperative pain score was low, while other outcomes were of moderate quality.
CONCLUSION: Current evidence suggests that self-gripping mesh may reduce surgical time and early postoperative pain in Lichtenstein inguinal hernia repair. However, given the low quality of evidence for these outcomes, the findings should be interpreted cautiously. Further high-quality RCTs are needed to confirm these findings.

makaleler.baslik: Outcomes of anterior gastropexy in minimally invasive hiatal hernia repair: A systematic review and single-arm meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Minimal invaziv hiatal fıtık onarımında anteriyor gastropeksi sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Minimal invaziv paraözofageal fıtık onarımında anteriyor gastropeksiyi inceleyen 15 çalışmanın meta-analizinde (931 hasta), fıtık nüks oranı %13,44 (%95 CI 10,09-17,68) olarak saptanmıştır. Ameliyat sonrası reflü %6,49, disfaji %6,54, yeniden ameliyat oranı ise %4,71 bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Paraesophageal hernia (PEH) can significantly impact quality of life and may lead to life-threatening complications. Although minimally invasive hernia repair (MISHR) is considered safe, it remains associated with relatively high recurrence rates. This study evaluates anterior gastropexy (AG) during MISHR as a potential operative strategy to reduce recurrence in PEH.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane databases were searched for studies evaluating AG during MISHR for PEH treatment. The primary outcome was hiatal hernia recurrence (HHR); secondary outcomes included postoperative reflux, postoperative dysphagia, mortality, reoperation, conversion to open surgery, operative time duration in minutes, and hospital stay in days.
RESULTS: A total of 15 studies were included, comprising 931 patients undergoing AG during MISHR. HHR occurred in 13 non-overlapping observational studies including 803 patients, with a pooled recurrence rate of 13.44% (95% CI, 10.09 to 17.68). Post-operative reflux was reported in 6.49% of cases (95% CI, 1.56 to 23.32), while post-operative dysphagia was present in 6.54% (95% CI, 3.71 to 11.27). Pooled mortality was 0.44% (95% CI, 0.04 to 4.21). Reoperation and conversion to open were necessary in 4.71% (95% CI, 2.42 to 8.97) and 1.38% (95% CI, 0.33 to 5.57), respectively.
CONCLUSION: In patients with PEH, HHR after MISHR with AG was estimated descriptively, alongside low rates of mortality, reoperation, and conversion to open surgery in the included cohorts. The only RCT favored AG, and these findings support further comparative studies.

makaleler.baslik: When benign prostatic hyperplasia meets inguinal hernia: Development of a multidisciplinary management framework for elderly men.
makaleler.baslik_tr: BPH ve kasık fıtığı birlikteliğinde multidisipliner yönetim yaklaşımı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: BPH ve kasık fıtığı birlikteliği olan hastalar üzerine yapılan literatür derlemesinde, RETAINER I çalışmasında ameliyat sonrası idrar retansiyonu (POUR) %5,8 bulunmuştur. Rutin kateterizasyonun fayda sağlamadığı ve eş zamanlı cerrahinin yalnızca her iki işlem için de bağımsız endikasyon olduğunda uygulanabileceği belirtilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS) / Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH) and inguinal hernia (IH) are prevalent conditions among elderly men and frequently coexist in clinical practice. However, their concurrent management remains fragmented because they are traditionally addressed within separate surgical and urological specialties. This review aims to synthesize evidence relevant to men with coexisting LUTS/BPH and IH, also, to propose a multidisciplinary clinical pathway for the assessment and management of elderly patients presenting with these comorbidities.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase (Ovid), and Web of Science Core Collection were searched from inception to August 2026. Among 752 unique database records, 172 underwent detailed assessment and 44 reports were included. Reports were mapped by clinical question and study design, including question-specific Oxford Centre for Evidence-Based Medicine levels.
RESULTS: The 44 reports addressed coexistence, postoperative urinary retention (POUR) risk, POUR prevention, and combined or staged operations. In RETAINER I (n = 4,151), POUR occurred in 5.8% of men and 9.5% of men aged 65 years or older. Previous retention predicted risk, whereas diagnosed benign prostatic enlargement and International Prostate Symptom Score were not independent predictors. A randomized trial found no benefit from routine intraoperative catheterization, and overlapping alpha-blocker meta-analyses were discordant. Evidence for a causal benign prostatic hyperplasia-hernia relationship was inconsistent and confounded. Combined surgery was feasible in selected series, but comparative evidence was sparse and did not establish a preferred sequence.
CONCLUSION: The framework is a decision aid, not a validated protocol. Disease-specific indications should determine priority. Combined surgery may be considered only when both procedures are independently indicated and local expertise permits.

makaleler.baslik: Unmasking mental health discrepancies in ventral hernia repair.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Ventral herni onarımında ruh sağlığı farklılıklarının ortaya çıkarılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: ACHQC veritabanında ventral herni onarımı yapılan 11943 hasta retrospektif incelenmiştir. Kadınlarda anksiyete (%7,5 vs %3,8, p<0,001) ve depresyon (%6,3 vs %2,9, p<0,001) daha yüksek saptanmıştır. Psikiyatrik bozukluğu olanlarda hastanede kalış süresi daha kısa bulunurken [3 gün vs 4 gün, p<0,001], ağrı daha fazla ve yaşam kalitesi düşük izlenmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Psychiatric comorbidities such as anxiety and depression are increasingly recognized as important determinants influencing surgical and patient-reported outcomes. The effects of these diagnoses are poorly understood in hernia patients. The aim of this study is to evaluate anxiety and depression rates within the Abdominal Core Health Quality Collaborative (ACHQC), investigate gender differences, and examine the impact of mental health co-morbidities on postoperative outcomes.
METHODS: A retrospective analysis of adult patients with a psychiatric comorbidity undergoing ventral hernia repair in the ACHQC was conducted. Demographic variables, including anxiety and depression were extracted and stratified by sex. Using 1:2 propensity score matching, comparative analyses assessed differences in psychiatric comorbidity rates between genders and associations with postoperative outcomes.
RESULTS: A total of 11943 patients were included, 6296 (52.7%) females and 5647 (47.3%) males. Anxiety and depression rates were 5.7% and 4.7%, respectively. Females exhibited higher rates of anxiety (7.5% vs. 3.8%, p < 0.001) and depression (6.3% vs. 2.9%, p < 0.001) compared to males. Patients with mental health disorders had worse pain and lower quality of life at baseline, 30 days, and 1 year. Patients with anxiety or depression had a shorter postoperative hospital stay compared to those without the diagnosis [3 days (IQR 1,6) vs. 4 days (IQR 2,6), p < 0.001].
CONCLUSIONS: Approximately 1 in 10 ventral hernia patients present with depression or anxiety, with higher prevalence among females. These psychiatric conditions are associated with worse postoperative pain and lower quality of life.

tez.baslik: Alt batın cerrahisi geçirmiş inguinal herni hastalarında total ekstraperitoneal inguinal herni onarımının (tep) uygulanabilirliği
tez.baslik_tr: Alt batın cerrahisi geçirmiş hastalarda TEP inguinal herni onarımının uygulanabilirliği
tez.kisa_ozet: Alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü değerlendirilen 159 inguinal herni hastasında TEP (%65,4, n=104) ve Lichtenstein (%31,4, n=50) onarımları prospektif karşılaştırılmıştır. Geçirilmiş cerrahi öyküsü olan TEP grubunda peritoneal defekt oranı yüksek saptanmıştır (p<0,05). Toplam nüks oranı %0,6 olup yalnızca açık cerrahi uygulanan grupta gözlenmiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu prospektif gözlemsel çalışma, daha önce alt batın cerrahisi geçirmiş hastalarda total ekstraperitoneal (TEP) inguinal herni onarımının uygulanabilirliğini, güvenliğini ve klinik sonuçlarını değerlendirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Alt batın cerrahisi sonrası gelişen preperitoneal yapışıklıklar, cerrahlar için teknik zorluk ve komplikasyon riski endişesi yaratmaktadır. Bu çalışma, TEP yönteminin bu hasta grubunda güvenle uygulanabileceğini nesnel verilerle ortaya koymayı hedeflemiştir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Şubat 2025 ile Eylül 2025 tarihleri arasında Etlik Şehir Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde prospektif olarak yürütülen bu çalışmaya toplam 159 hasta dâhil edilmiştir. Hastalar üç gruba ayrılmıştır: • Grup 1: Açık Lichtenstein onarımı yapılan hastalar, • Grup 2: Alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü olmayan TEP olguları, • Grup 3: Alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü bulunan TEP olguları. Tüm hastalarda demografik veriler, fıtık tipi ve tarafı, intraoperatif bulgular (özellikle peritoneal defekt oranı), postoperatif komplikasyonlar, EQ-5D ve EQ-VAS yaşam kalitesi skorları ile işe dönüş süreleri kaydedilmiştir. Veriler parametrik ve non-parametrik istatistiksel yöntemlerle analiz edilmiştir. Bulgular: Olguların %65.4'üne (n=104) TEP, %31.4'üne (n=50) açık Lichtenstein onarımı uygulanmıştır. Alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü bulunan TEP hastalarında peritoneal defekt oranı anlamlı olarak yüksek bulunmuştur (p 0.05). Nüks oranı %0.6 olup yalnızca açık cerrahi grubunda gözlenmiştir. Sonuç: Bu çalışma, alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü bulunan hastalarda TEP yönteminin güvenli, uygulanabilir ve klinik olarak avantajlı bir seçenek olduğunu göstermektedir. Diseksiyon teknik olarak daha zor olsa da komplikasyon, nüks ve yaşam kalitesi sonuçları benzer düzeydedir. Bununla birlikte, aynı hastalara TEP yerine açık Lichtenstein yöntemi uygulanması halinde morbidite, seroma oranı ve iyileşme süresinde anlamlı olumsuzluklar gözlenecektir. TEP, deneyimli cerrahlar tarafından uygulandığında, sadece minimal invaziv bir yöntem değil; aynı zamanda hasta güvenliği, yaşam kalitesi ve fonksiyonel iyileşmeyi optimize eden modern bir cerrahi yaklaşımdır. Bu bulgular, alt batın cerrahisi öyküsü bulunan hastalarda da TEP'in standart tedavi seçenekleri arasına güvenle dahil edilebileceğini göstermektedir.

makaleler.baslik: Machine Learning for Predicting Delayed Graft Function and Graft Survival After Kidney Transplantation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Naklinde Gecikmiş Greft Fonksiyonunu Tahmin Etmede Makine Öğrenimi Meta-Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 217 çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde böbrek nakli sonrası DGF ve greft sağkalımı tahmin modelleri değerlendirildi. Irish 2010 DGF modelinin havuzlanmış AUC değeri 0,73 (%95 CI 0,69-0,77) saptandı. ML ile regresyon arasındaki AUC farkı 0,01 (IQR -0,02 ile 0,03) bulundu ve 208 çalışma yüksek yanlılık riski taşıyordu.
makaleler.ozet: Background/Objectives: Machine-learning (ML) models are promoted for predicting delayed graft function (DGF) and graft survival after kidney transplantation; we examined whether they outperform regression and how well either has been validated. Methods: We searched PubMed/MEDLINE, Embase, and Web of Science through 28 June 2026, searched citations for named DGF models, extracted data in duplicate, assessed risk of bias using the Prediction Model Risk of Bias ASsessment Tool (PROBAST), and pooled only external validations of the same published model. Results: We included 217 reports (145 on DGF and 91 on graft survival, 19 on both); across seven external cohorts, the Irish 2010 DGF model had a pooled area under the curve (AUC) of 0.73 (95% confidence interval 0.69-0.77), the median difference in AUC or C-statistic between ML and regression in 28 same-cohort comparisons was 0.01 (interquartile range -0.02 to 0.03), and 208 of the 212 non-pediatric reports were at high risk of bias. Conclusions: ML has not been shown to predict DGF or graft survival better than regression, and the comparisons are too heterogeneous to show that it is worse; a model should inform organ acceptance or recipient counseling only after it has shown discrimination and calibration in an independent cohort.

makaleler.baslik: Comparison of the effects of normal saline versus Plasma-Lyte® on acid-base balance during living donor kidney transplantation surgery using goal-directed fluid therapy based on pulse pressure variation- a randomised controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Canlı vericili böbrek naklinde Serum Fizyolojik ile Plasma-Lyte karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Canlı vericili böbrek naklinde 111 hastayla yapılan RCT'de, PPV rehberliğinde uygulanan serum fizyolojik ve Plasma-Lyte sıvı tedavileri karşılaştırılmıştır. İki grup arasında asit-baz dengesi ve erken greft disfonksiyonu (%4,1 vs %7,4; p=0,472) açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Normal saline (NS) is commonly used during kidney transplantation but may cause hyperchloremic metabolic acidosis when administered in large volumes. Balanced crystalloids such as Plasma-Lyte® (PL) may attenuate these effects. We compared acid-base outcomes of NS versus PL when administered using pulse pressure variation (PPV)- guided goal-directed fluid therapy during living donor kidney transplantation (LDKT).
MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this prospective randomised assessor-blinded trial, adult patients undergoing LDKT were allocated to receive intraoperative NS or PL. Fluid administration was titrated according to a predefined PPV-guided algorithm. Acid-base status was assessed using the Stewart physicochemical analysis. The primary endpoint was the difference in apparent strong ion difference (SIDa). Secondary outcome measurements included haemodynamics, electrolytes, lactate, serum creatinine trends, dialysis requirement, and graft function.
RESULTS: A total of 111 patients were analysed (NS, n = 55, PL, n = 56). Baseline characteristics and total intraoperative fluid volumes were comparable (1796 ± 337 vs 1903 ± 434 mL; p = 0.15). Apparent strong ion difference declined over time in both groups (time effect p < 0.001), but did not differ between groups (group effect p = 0.50; interaction p = 0.37). In the baseline-adjusted analysis (ANCOVA) of the primary endpoint, the adjusted between-group difference in SIDa at the end of surgery was 0.71 mmol/L (90% CI - 0.90 to + 2.32 mmol/L) against the pre-specified equivalence margin of ± 2 mmol/L; formal equivalence was not established, although no significant difference was detected (adjusted p = 0.46). Effective strong ion difference (SID e), strong ion gap (SIG), pH, serum potassium, and lactate were similar at all measured time points (p > 0.05). Early graft dysfunction (4.1% vs 7.4%; p = 0.472) and delayed graft function (3.6% vs 0%; p = 0.150) did not differ significantly; however, the trial was not powered for these exploratory outcomes. Postoperative creatinine trajectories did not differ between groups.
CONCLUSION: During LDKT, PPV-guided goal-directed fluid therapy produced no significant between-group difference in acid-base balance or early graft outcomes with NS and PL. Formal equivalence in the primary endpoint was not established; nonetheless, at the moderate volumes delivered, the findings suggest that haemodynamic strategy may influence perioperative acid-base status more than crystalloid choice.
CLINICAL TRIALS REGISTRATION DETAILS: The study was prospectively registered in the Clinical Trials Registry of India (ctri.nic.in) Registration number: CTRI/2021/01/030227 Registered on 04/01/2021.

makaleler.baslik: Efficacy of Virtual Reality Exercises in Sarcopenic Patients After Liver Transplantation: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer nakli sonrası sarkopenik hastalarda sanal gerçeklik egzersizlerinin etkinliği
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Karaciğer nakli sonrası sarkopenisi olan 60 hastada yapılan RCT'de, konvansiyonel rehabilitasyona sanal gerçeklik eklenmesinin 6 hafta sonunda el sıkma kuvvetini (fark 9,55 kg), 6 dakika yürüme mesafesini (fark 172,31 m) ve fiziksel fonksiyonu (p<0,001) anlamlı düzeyde artırdığı gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether adding virtual reality (VR) exercise to conventional rehabilitation improves handgrip and pinch-grip strength, quadriceps muscle strength, respiratory function, quality of life (QoL), fatigue, and exercise capacity in sarcopenic patients after liver transplantation (LT).
DESIGN: A randomized clinical trial.
SETTING: Outpatient physical therapy clinics.
PARTICIPANTS: Sixty patients suffering from sarcopenia after LT, aged 18-65 years, were randomly allocated to two equal groups.
INTERVENTION: The study group received VR exercise plus conventional physical therapy. The control group received conventional physical therapy only. Interventions were applied three times a week for 6 weeks.
OUTCOME MEASURES: Handgrip strength (HGS), pinch-grip strength, quadriceps muscle strength, respiratory function, fatigue severity, QoL, and exercise capacity were measured at baseline and after 6 weeks of interventions.
RESULTS: Between-group differences were observed for HGS, pinch-grip strength, quadriceps muscle strength, respiratory function, fatigue severity, QoL, and exercise capacity after 6 weeks, favoring the study group (P < 0.001). Mean differences (95% confidence interval) between groups were 9.55 kg (6.66, 12.44) for hand grip; 4.39 kg (2.27, 6.51) for quadriceps muscle strength; 172.31 meter (93.43, 251.19) for 6-minute walk test; -1.54 (-2.17, -0.91) for fatigue severity; and 12.70 (6.14, 19.26) for physical function after 6 weeks.
CONCLUSIONS: Adding VR exercise to conventional rehabilitation was more beneficial than conventional rehabilitation alone in improving HGS, pinch-grip strength, quadriceps muscle strength, respiratory function, QoL, fatigue severity, and exercise capacity in sarcopenic patients after LT. Therefore, it may be considered a potentially useful adjunct to conventional rehabilitation in this population.

makaleler.baslik: Expanding transplant access via robotics: a multi-center American experience with 671 robotic kidney transplants.
makaleler.baslik_tr: 671 Robotik Böbrek Naklinde Çok Merkezli Deneyim ve Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Üç merkezde yapılan 671 robotik böbrek nakli geriye dönük incelendi. Açığa geçiş %0,6, gecikmiş greft fonksiyonu %16,2 ve majör komplikasyon %12,1 oranında görüldü. Hastaların 1, 3 ve 5 yıllık greft sağkalımı sırasıyla %96,9, %93,4 ve %86,8 olarak saptandı. Robotik böbrek naklinin güvenli ve teknik olarak uygulanabilir olduğu belirtildi.
makaleler.ozet: The safety of robotic kidney transplantation has been shown in single-center studies, but multi-institutional outcomes in America remain understudied. This was a retrospective analysis of 671 robotic kidney transplants across three institutions, with data collected from the start of their robotic kidney transplant programs through December 2025. Outcomes were stratified by recipient body mass index, donor type, and renal artery anatomy. Median recipient age was 49 years, and 58.0% were male. Most patients had obesity (87.8%), with 47.5% having morbid obesity. Most (55.1%) received living donor grafts. Median operative and warm ischemia times were 273 and 44 min, respectively. Conversion to open surgery occurred in 0.6% of cases. Delayed graft function occurred in 16.2% of recipients, and major complications in 12.1%; neither differed by recipient body mass index. Patient survival was significantly lower for patients with BMI ≥ 40 (p < 0.001). Delayed graft function varied by donor type, ranging from 2.2% (living donor) to 48.3% (donation after circulatory death with rapid recovery). Patient survival at 1, 3, and 5 years post-transplant was 96.5%, 92.5%, and 87.3%; graft survival was 96.9%, 93.4%, and 86.8%, respectively. Robotic kidney transplantation was safe and technically reproducible with appropriate perioperative outcomes across three American transplant centers.

makaleler.baslik: Varied trajectories through the transplant evaluation process: Results of a sequence analysis among a national cohort of Veterans with advanced kidney disease.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İleri Böbrek Hastalarında Böbrek Nakli Değerlendirme Süreçlerinin Analizi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: İleri evre böbrek yetmezliği olan 39.691 gazide 5 yıllık nakil değerlendirme süreçleri dizilim analizi ile incelendi. Süreçte 7 farklı yörünge tanımlandı: erken ölüm (%50,5), zamanında bekleme listesine alma (%3,3) ve zamanında nakil (%1,9). İleri yaş ve komorbidite yüksekliği nakil sürecinde gecikmelerle ilişkili bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Efforts to improve access to kidney transplant are limited by an incomplete view on the full arc of the evaluation process. We performed a retrospective cohort study among 39,691 adults receiving care within the US Veterans Affairs Health Care System (VA) with incident advanced kidney disease (eGFR≤20 mL/min/1.73 m2) between 10/1/2011 and 12/31/2018. We used sequence analysis to describe sequential steps in the transplant process over 5 years of follow-up. Cohort members' median age at cohort entry was 70.1 (IQR 63.9, 80.2) years and 97.2% were men. Sequence analysis yielded 7 distinct trajectories through the transplant process: 1) early death (50.5%), 2) transplant not mentioned (24.6%), 3) not pursuing transplant (6.2%), 4) prolonged deliberation (4.6%), 5) prolonged evaluation (8.9%), 6) timely waitlisting (3.3%), and 7) timely transplant (1.9%). Older age, higher comorbidity index, and higher area deprivation index were associated with a lower likelihood of experiencing trajectories representing timely progression through the transplant process and a greater likelihood of not engaging with the process or spending prolonged periods of time in early steps. Our findings suggest that current efforts to encourage broader referral for transplant should be complemented by a more streamlined evaluation process and support for shared decision-making.

makaleler.baslik: From consensus statements to clinical practice- PSOGI consensus recommendations clarifying optimal management of peritoneal malignancy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Peritoneal Maligniteler İçin Optimal Yönetim Kılavuzları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: PSOGI konsensus önerileri, CRS ve HIPEC gibi tedavileri standardize ederek PM yönetimini iyileştirmeyi amaçlamaktadır. Bu derleme, geçmiş konsensus önerilerini ve klinik pratikteki uygulamalarını özetlemektedir.
makaleler.ozet: The peritoneal surface oncology group international (PSOGI) was founded by a group of surgeons who defined and pioneered the definitive treatment of peritoneal malignancies (PM). Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) and hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) were introduced in the 1980s, and subsequently refined and shown to be reproducible. This combined treatment changed the outlook of many PM from incurable end-stage conditions to treatable diseases with a possibility of cure and/or long term-survival. In the last 25 years, through various consensuses, PSOGI has worked to standardize CRS, establish treatment pathways for PM, transform peritoneal surface oncology from a surgical to a multidisciplinary specialty and promote clinical and translational research on PM. This manuscript summarizes the main recommendations of the PSOGI consensuses conducted in the past two decades, discussing their clinical utility and application in current clinical practice. Adoption of these recommendations in routine care is essential both for optimizing current treatment and its outcomes and facilitating future research.

makaleler.baslik: Reflectance confocal microscopy for melanoma: systematic review with evidence-based recommendations.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Melanomda reflektans konfokal mikroskopi kullanımına dair kanıta dayalı öneriler
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 70 çalışma ve 13 sistematik derlemenin analizinde, konfokal mikroskopi ikincil test olarak özgüllüğü %82'ye yükseltmiş ve biyopsi ihtiyacını %23-61 azaltmıştır. Lentigo malignada cerrahi öncesi haritalama cerrahi evre sayısını düşürmüştür (1,7'ye karşı 1,1).
makaleler.ozet: Dermoscopy has limited specificity for equivocal melanocytic lesions, causing unnecessary excisions. Reflectance confocal microscopy offers noninvasive, near-histological imaging, but evidence remains scattered. This review graded evidence across six melanoma applications (diagnosis, excision reduction, margin mapping, treatment monitoring, cost-effectiveness, and teledermatology) and derived recommendations. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses 2020 (PROSPERO CRD420261329819), PubMed, Web of Science, and Embase were searched (January 2005 to March 2026). Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment (QUADAS-2, AMSTAR-2, CHEC). Evidence was graded (National Health and Medical Research Council) and synthesized narratively. Seventy primary studies and 13 systematic reviews were included. As a second-level test after dermoscopy, confocal microscopy preserved sensitivity (pooled 92-94%) and improved specificity (82 vs. 42% at 90% sensitivity). In the only diagnostic randomized trial, the number needed to excise fell 43%; real-world cohorts spared 23-61% of biopsies. For lentigo maligna, confocal microscopy was more sensitive and specific than dermoscopy and outperformed clinical and dermoscopic assessment for treatment failure; presurgical mapping reduced surgical stages (1.7 vs. 1.1). Two economic evaluations reported 27-49% lower costs per melanoma. Evidence was weaker for amelanotic, nodular, and acral melanoma, scoring systems, and teledermatology; risk of bias was often high or unclear. Four of 13 recommendations reached grade B, eight grade C, and one grade D. Evidence supports confocal microscopy as a second-level tool in specialist practice for dermoscopically equivocal melanocytic lesions, facial lentigo maligna diagnosis, reducing unnecessary excisions, and presurgical margin mapping. Multicentre randomized trials should precede broader adoption.

makaleler.baslik: Local Control Options for Metastatic Disease in Sarcoma.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Sarkomlarda metastatik hastalık için lokal tedavi seçenekleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Oligometastatik yumuşak doku sarkomlarında akciğer metastazektomisi %20-58 5 yıllık OS sağlar. R0 rezeksiyon, uzun hastalıksız sağkalım ve az sayıda metastaz iyi sonuçlarla ilişkilidir. Stereotaktik radyoterapi ve termal ablasyon cerrahiye tamamlayıcı seçenekler sunmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE OF REVIEW: To review the current evidence on local treatment strategies for oligometastatic soft tissue sarcoma at pulmonary and extrapulmonary sites, and evaluate their impact on oncological outcomes.
RECENT FINDINGS: Pulmonary metastasectomy remains the most established local treatment, with 5-year survival rates of 20-58%. Complete (R0) resection, a longer disease-free interval, and fewer metastases are associated with improved outcomes. Stereotactic radiotherapy achieves high local control rates with low toxicity, and a recent systematic review reported survival outcomes comparable to surgery. Image-guided thermal ablation also achieves high local control rates for lung metastases of 1 cm or smaller and offers a minimally invasive option for extrapulmonary metastases. For all modalities, current data are derived predominantly from retrospective studies, and direct comparisons are lacking. Local treatment offers promising outcomes for carefully selected patients with oligometastatic soft tissue sarcoma. Surgery, stereotactic radiotherapy, and thermal ablation should be considered complementary options, selected within a multidisciplinary tumor board according to lesion size, number, and location. Prospective studies are needed to define optimal patient selection and determine the comparative effectiveness of these modalities.

makaleler.baslik: The Impact of Tumor Molecular Profile on Prognosis for Patients With Peritoneal Metastases From Colorectal Cancer Undergoing Cytoreductive Surgery and Hyperthermic Intraperitoneal Chemotherapy.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Kolorektal peritoneal metastazlarda CRS ve HIPEC sonrası moleküler profilin etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: CRS ve HIPEC uygulanan 159 kolorektal peritoneal metastaz hastasında genetik mutasyon varlığı daha kısa medyan RFS ile ilişkili bulunmuştur (8 aya karşı 27 ay; p<0,001). Çok değişkenli analizde mutasyon durumu nüks için bağımsız risk faktörüdür (HR 3,821; p<0,001).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Cytoreductive surgery (CRS) with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (HIPEC) improves survival in selected patients with colorectal peritoneal metastases. However, outcomes remain heterogeneous, and tumor molecular biology may influence prognosis.
METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed patients with colorectal cancer and peritoneal metastases treated with CRS and HIPEC at Royal Hospital between May 2013 and August 2024. Patients were grouped by presence of genetic mutations (GM) versus no mutations (no-GM). Primary outcomes were overall survival (OS) and recurrence-free survival (RFS). Secondary outcomes included morbidity and prognostic factors for recurrence.
RESULTS: Among 159 patients, 73 (45.9%) had a documented genetic mutation. Genetic mutation was associated with a shorter median RFS (8 months in the GM group vs. 27 months in the no-GM group; p < 0.001), with 5-year RFS of 6.0% and 45.3%, respectively. Genetic mutation was also associated with a shorter median OS on univariable analysis (37 months vs. not reached; p = 0.001). On multivariable analysis, genetic mutation status (HR 3.821, 95% CI 2.270-6.432; p < 0.001), PCI > 15 (HR 1.073; p = 0.005), and pre-HIPEC chemotherapy (HR 2.194; p = 0.003) were independently associated with recurrence. For OS, PCI (HR 1.066; p = 0.037) and poorly differentiated tumor grade (HR 2.946; p = 0.045) were independently associated with survival, whereas genetic mutation status was not (HR 1.477; p = 0.197).
CONCLUSION: Genetic mutation was associated with shorter RFS after CRS and HIPEC, and this association persisted after multivariable adjustment. The association with OS was not independent of PCI and tumor grade, suggesting that disease burden may be the main driver of survival. Molecular status may complement established clinicopathological factors in patient assessment; larger prospective studies stratified by mutation type are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Primary Gastric Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors in the Robotic Era: A 15-Year Single-center Experience with Minimally Invasive Surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Robotik Era Döneminde Primer Gastrik GIST Cerrahisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 263 hastanın incelendiği bu tek merkezli çalışmada, primer gastrik GIST tedavisinde minimal invasif cerrahi ve robotik yaklaşımın güvenli olduğu ve wedge rezeksiyonun çoğunlukla tercih edildiği gösterildi. MIS ile >5 cm kitlelerde %97,5 R0 rezeksiyon oranına ulaşıldı ve anatomik gastrektomiden kaçınıldı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Complete resection is central to curative-intent treatment of primary gastric gastrointestinal stromal tumors. Although minimally invasive surgery (MIS) is appealing, evidence for robotic resection of large or anatomically difficult tumors remains limited.
METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed patients undergoing resection of primary gastric gastrointestinal stromal tumors at the Mayo Clinic, Rochester (2010-2025). Demographics, operative details, pathology, and outcomes were summarized descriptively. Recurrence-free survival (RFS) and overall survival (OS) were estimated using Kaplan-Meier methods.
RESULTS: Among 263 patients, the median tumor size was 4.0 cm; 31% exceeded 5 cm. Laparoscopy was used in 42.2%, open surgery in 30.0%, and robotics in 27.8%, with robotic use increasing over time and predominating by 2025. Wedge resection was most common (79.8%), followed by transgastric resection (15.9%); intraoperative endoscopy was used in 40.6%. R0 resection was achieved in 97.7%, with no intraoperative tumor ruptures and a 3.3% conversion rate among MIS cases. In the analytic cohort (n = 173), MIS was used for 75.5% of tumors > 5 cm and all cardia tumors and was associated with lower blood loss and shorter hospital stay. Median RFS and OS were not reached; 5-year RFS and OS were 78.1 and 85.0%. RFS differed by tumor grade (p = 0.009). Among MIS resections of tumors > 5 cm (n = 40), R0 was 97.5%, with no conversions or ruptures; R0 reached 100% for cardia/gastroesophageal junction/incisura tumors (n = 15). Anatomic gastrectomy was avoided in 86% of MIS cases.
CONCLUSIONS: Outcomes depended more on patient selection and tailored technique than operative platform. MIS, including robotics, enabled safe, margin-negative resection with rapid recovery, whereas RFS reflected tumor biology.

tez.baslik: Peritoneal karsinomatozu olan gastrointestinal malignitelerde assit adipokinlerinin değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: GİS Malignitelerinde Peritoneal Karsinomatoz ve Assit Adipokinleri
tez.kisa_ozet: Parasentez uygulanan 48 hastanın incelendiği prospektif çalışmada, asit sıvısı resistin düzeylerinin malign ve benign asitin ayırt edilmesinde potansiyel biyobelirteç olabileceği (%79,4 duyarlılık, %57,1 özgüllük) saptandı.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Peritoneal karsinomatozis, ileri evre gastrointestinal (GI) kanserlerde sık görülen bir klinik tablodur. Son çalışmalar, adipoz doku tarafından salgılanan biyoaktif sitokinler olan adipokinlerin, tümör progresyonu ve malign effüzyon oluşumundaki potansiyel rollerini vurgulamıştır. Bu çalışmanın amacı, GI kanserlere ve malign asite sahip hastaların asit sıvısındaki adipokin düzeylerini (adiponektin, adipzin, leptin ve resistin) konjestif kalp yetmezliğine bağlı benign transüdatif asitli hastalarla karşılaştırmaktır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu prospektif, gözlemsel çalışmaya parasentez uygulanan 48 hasta dahil edildi. Bunların 32'sinde peritoneal karsinomatozis kaynaklı malign asit (gastrik ve kolorektal kanser gruplarına ayrıldı), 16'sında ise konjestif kalp yetmezliğine bağlı benign asit mevcuttu. Asit sıvısı örneklerinde ELISA yöntemiyle adiponektin, adipzin, leptin ve resistin düzeyleri analiz edildi. Rutin biyokimyasal parametreler de değerlendirildi. Bulgular: İncelenen tüm adipokinler arasında yalnızca resistin düzeyleri malign ve benign asit grupları arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı fark gösterdi (p<0.05); malign grupta belirgin şekilde daha düşük resistin düzeyleri saptandı. Adiponektin, adipsin ve leptin düzeyleri gruplar arasında anlamlı fark göstermedi. Alt grup analizinde, resistin düzeylerindeki azalışın esas olarak gastrik kanser grubuyla ilişkili olduğu görüldü. ROC eğrisi analizinde, asit sıvısı resistin düzeylerinin malign asiti benign asitten ayırmada %79.4 duyarlılık ve %57.1 özgüllük sağladığı belirlendi. Sonuç: Asit sıvısındaki resistin düzeyleri, malign ve benign asitin ayırt edilmesinde potansiyel bir biyobelirteç olabilir. Ancak özgüllüğünün nispeten düşük olması, bu belirtecin daha geniş bir tanısal panelin parçası olarak kullanılmasının daha uygun olacağını düşündürmektedir. Bu bulgular, peritoneal karsinomatoziste adipokin dinamiklerinin daha iyi anlaşılmasına katkı sağlamakta ve tümör mikroçevresini hedefleyen tanısal ve terapötik stratejilere yönelik gelecekteki araştırmalar için yol göstermektedir. makaleler.baslik: Oral versus intravenous postoperative antibiotics after laparoscopic appendectomy following complicated appendicitis: an open-label cluster-randomized cluster-crossover multiperiod non-inferiority study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Komplike Apandisit Sonrası Oral ve İntravenöz Antibiyotik Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 12 Danimarka hastanesinde komplike apandisit nedeniyle laparoskopik apendektomi yapılan 1021 hastada, 3 günlük oral ve intravenöz antibiyotik rejimleri karşılaştırıldı. İntra-abdominal abse insidansı oral grupta %6,8, intravenöz grupta %4,9 olarak saptandı ve oral tedavinin non-inferior olduğu gösterildi. Oral antibiyotikler hastane kalış süresini kısalttı (-41,1 saat), ancak yeniden yatış oranını artırdı (fark %4,7).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The optimal administration route and duration of postoperative antibiotics for complicated appendicitis after source control remain debated. The aim of this non-inferiority cluster-randomized trial was to compare oral versus intravenous antibiotics following laparoscopic appendectomy.
METHODS: In this pragmatic, open-label, cluster-randomized, cluster-crossover, non-inferiority trial across 12 Danish hospitals, adults undergoing laparoscopic appendectomy for complicated appendicitis received either a 3-day oral or intravenous postoperative antibiotic regimen. The primary outcome was 30-day intra-abdominal abscess, analysed in both intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations using a 5% points non-inferiority margin. Secondary 30-day outcomes included length of hospital stay, readmission, and postoperative complications.
RESULTS: Of 5424 patients screened, 1021 with complicated appendicitis were allocated to oral (n = 567) or intravenous (n = 454) antibiotics. In the intention-to-treat analysis, intra-abdominal abscess occurred in 39 of 567 oral and 22 of 454 intravenous patients; weighted 30-day incidences were 6.8% and 4.9% (absolute risk difference, 1.9%; 90% c.i., -0.4 to 4.2), meeting non-inferiority. In the per-protocol analysis, abscess occurred in 19 of 395 and 9 of 294 patients; weighted incidences were 4.9% and 3.0% (absolute risk difference, 1.8%; 90% c.i., -0.3 to 3.9). Oral antibiotics shortened hospital stay (-41.1 h; 95% c.i., -46.7 to -35.6) but increased readmission (difference, 4.7%; 95% c.i., 0.5 to 8.9).
CONCLUSIONS: A 3-day oral antibiotic regimen was non-inferior to intravenous antibiotic therapy in preventing intra-abdominal abscess after laparoscopic appendectomy for complicated appendicitis. Reduced hospital stay and comparable clinical outcomes support oral antibiotics as a routine postoperative option in clinically stable patients.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT04803422.

makaleler.baslik: Explosive Weapons Trauma Care Collective (EXTRACCT) Blast Injury Clinical Practice Guideline: Abdominal Blast Injuries.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Abdominal Patlama Yaralanmalarında Klinik Pratik Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Kaynak kısıtlı ortamlarda abdominal patlama yaralanmalarının yönetimi için yarı yapılandırılmış bir literatür taraması yürütüldü. Kılavuz, resüsitasyon, kanama kontrolü ve bağırsak yönetimine öncelik vererek morbidite ve mortaliteyi azaltmayı amaçlayan cerrahi teknikler ve görüntüleme yaklaşımları sunmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: This guideline from the Explosive Weapons Trauma Care Collective (EXTRACCT) outlines best practices for managing abdominal blast injuries in resource-limited environments, especially after blast injuries from explosive ordnance including improvised explosive devices. Such injuries are particularly prevalent in lower-income regions with limited medical resources, making effective management crucial.
METHODS: A semi-structured literature review was conducted to identify evidence-based practices for abdominal trauma care in low-resource environments.
RESULTS: The guideline provides key assessment points and management strategies for abdominal blast injuries, with interventions adapted to the severity of tissue and organ damage. It includes surgical techniques, imaging approaches, and adjunct therapies designed to support surgeons operating in low-resource settings, where access to advanced tools and specialist care may be limited.
CONCLUSION: Abdominal trauma following blast incidents can be managed effectively in austere settings by prioritizing resuscitation, hemorrhage control and bowel management. This structured approach can reduce morbidity and mortality, even in resource-constrained environments.

makaleler.baslik: Predictors of Emergency Surgery in Acute Ischaemic Colitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Akut İskemik Kolitte Acil Cerrahi Prediktörleri: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Akut iskemik kolitte acil cerrahi ile ilişkili faktörleri değerlendirmek amacıyla 26 kohort çalışması incelendi. Hipotansiyon ve sağ kolon tutulumu için geleneksel tahminler daha yüksek acil cerrahi olasılığı öne sürse de, Hartung-Knapp güven aralıkları nedeniyle istatistiksel olarak robust bir pooled ilişki saptanamadı ve kanıt kesinliği çok düşük bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Background: Acute ischaemic colitis ranges from reversible mucosal injury to transmural necrosis requiring emergency resection. This review aimed to identify factors associated with emergency surgery, quantify comparable unadjusted associations, and assess their robustness. Methods: PubMed, Cochrane Library, Embase, and Ovid MEDLINE were searched to 10 June 2026. Adult cohort studies reporting predictors or outcomes relevant to emergency surgery for ischaemic colitis (IC) were included. Surgery-specific unadjusted odds ratios (ORs) were pooled only when at least three independent, clinically comparable studies were available, using random-effects models with restricted maximum-likelihood estimation; Hartung-Knapp confidence intervals were used for primary inference. Risk of bias was assessed with QUIPS, and certainty with GRADE adapted for prognostic-factor evidence. The protocol was registered in PROSPERO (CRD420261411575). Results: Twenty-six cohort studies were included; five contributed data to at least one of three retained meta-analyses. Conventional REML estimates suggested higher odds of emergency surgery with hypotension (OR 3.53, 95% CI 1.10-11.28; I2 = 75.0%) and right-colonic involvement (OR 4.60, 95% CI 1.47-14.40; I2 = 80.4%), while fever was imprecise (OR 3.42, 95% CI 0.59-19.79; I2 = 86.3%). Hartung-Knapp 95% CIs included one for hypotension (0.30-41.71), fever (0.08-142.15), and right-colonic involvement (0.66-31.86), and no pooled association remained statistically robust. GRADE certainty was very low for all three. Conclusions: Hypotension and right-sided disease remain clinically plausible candidate risk markers, but the evidence is sparse and very uncertain and does not establish independent predictors or operative thresholds. Prospective multicentre studies using standardised definitions are needed to develop and externally validate a surgery-specific prediction model.

makaleler.baslik: Clinical characteristics, treatment, and prognosis of sexual-related rectal foreign bodies: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Cinsel Amaçlı Rektal Yabancı Cisimlerin Klinik Özellikleri ve Yönetimi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Cinsel amaçlı rektal yabancı cisim vakalarını inceleyen 59 çalışmadaki 376 hasta analiz edildi. Hastaların %98,1'i erkek olup %73,4'ünde transanal ekstraksiyon başarılı oldu, laparotomi oranı %19,2 ve bağırsak perforasyonu %4,7 (havuzlanmış %3,3) olarak saptandı.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Rectal foreign bodies (RFBs) inserted for sexual purposes are an increasingly reported surgical emergency, but the evidence remains fragmented across case reports and small series. We systematically reviewed the literature on sexual-related RFBs to characterize clinical features, management strategies, and outcomes.
METHODS: We searched major English- and Chinese-language databases for studies published from January 1, 2000 to July 31, 2026 that reported patients with RFBs related to sexual activity (PROSPERO registration CRD420261467581). Case reports, case series, and cohort studies were eligible. Patient-level pooled proportions with Wilson 95% CIs and random-effects meta-analyses of proportions (Freeman-Tukey transformation, DerSimonian-Laird estimator) across series with 5 or more patients were calculated. Study quality was assessed with Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) checklists and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale (NOS). Quality thresholds were defined a priori by the authors based on established conventions in the systematic review literature.
RESULTS: Fifty-nine studies (34 case reports, 21 case series, 4 cohort studies) from 22 countries, comprising 376 patients, were included; 40 studies were of high, 17 of moderate, and 2 of low quality. Most patients were male (98.1%), with a mean age of approximately 49 years; autoerotic insertion accounted for 92.5% of cases. Glass objects (20.3%) and sex toys (19.3%) were the most common foreign bodies. Overall, 61.4% of patients presented more than 24 h after insertion and 98.2% had attempted self-removal. Abdominal pain (25.9%) and rectal pain (24.6%) predominated. Transanal extraction was achieved in 73.4% of patients (meta-analytic estimate 71.9%, 95% CI, 60.8-81.9; I2 = 72.5%), laparotomy in 19.2%. Bowel perforation occurred in 4.7% (pooled 3.3%), stoma creation in 7.2% (pooled 5.1%), and mortality was 0.6% (pooled 1.4%, 95% CI, 0.4-3.0; I2 = 0%). Overall retrieval success was 99.7%.
CONCLUSION: Sexual-related RFBs occur predominantly in middle-aged men who present late, often after failed self-removal. Transanal extraction succeeds in most patients; perforation, stoma creation, and death are uncommon. A stepwise, escalation-based management approach is supported by the available evidence.

makaleler.baslik: Appendiceal mucocele in a high-volume surgical centre: clinicopathological variables associated with neoplastic disease, surgical outcomes, and a proposed institutional management algorithm: A retrospective cohort study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Appendiceal Mucocele Olgularında Neoplastik Hastalık ve Cerrahi Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Tek merkezli retrospektif kohort çalışmasında 4.126 apandisit vakasından 54 appendiceal mucocele olgusu incelendi. Neoplastik appendiceal mucocele yaşlı hasta, büyük lezyon çapı ve BT'de taban tutulumu ile ilişkili bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Appendiceal mucocele (AM) represents a clinicopathologically heterogeneous spectrum ranging from benign retention cysts to low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms (LAMN) and mucinous adenocarcinoma. Distinguishing neoplastic from benign AM preoperatively is essential to avert inadvertent perforation-related pseudomyxoma peritonei (PMP). The present study examines clinical, biological, and radiological predictors of neoplastic AM and proposes a hypothesis-generating institutional management framework.
METHODS: A retrospective cohort study of 4,126 consecutive appendiceal pathology cases managed at a single tertiary centre in Tunisia (January 2011-July 2022) was reported according to the Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) statement. Fifty-four patients with histologically confirmed AM were identified (incidence 1.31%). Given the 14 neoplastic events, comparative findings were considered exploratory and hypothesis-generating. Benign (n = 40) and neoplastic (n = 14) subgroups were compared. Prespecified candidate variables were evaluated using univariable Firth's penalized logistic regression, with bias-corrected odds ratios (OR) and 95% profile-likelihood confidence intervals (CI). The Benjamini-Hochberg false-discovery rate (FDR) procedure was applied to 15 prespecified inferential comparisons. CEA was measured selectively and was analysed as an exploratory biomarker because of verification bias; CA 19 - 9 was reported descriptively only because its group-specific ascertainment could not be reliably reconstructed.
RESULTS: Mean patient age was 46.0 ± 14.3 years; 29 were male (53.7%). CT identified AM preoperatively in 35 patients (64.8%). Twelve patients (22.2%) underwent completed laparoscopic surgery and 42 (77.8%) underwent open surgery. Histological subtypes comprised benign AM (74.1%), LAMN (18.5%), and mucinous adenocarcinoma (7.4%). Neoplastic AM was associated with older age (p = 0.009; Firth OR 1.05/year, 95% CI 1.01-1.11; FDR q = 0.019), larger lesion diameter (p < 0.001; FDR q < 0.002), diameter > 6 cm (Fisher's exact p < 0.001; Firth OR 18.6, 95% CI 2.8-124.1; FDR q < 0.001), CT base involvement (Fisher's exact p < 0.001; Firth OR 14.9, 95% CI 2.1-104.8; FDR q < 0.001), mural nodularity (Fisher's exact p = 0.002; Firth OR 12.3, 95% CI 1.7-90.1; FDR q = 0.006), and mural calcification (Fisher's exact p = 0.031; Firth OR 4.7, 95% CI 1.1-19.4; FDR q = 0.058). CEA was elevated in 5/14 neoplastic patients versus 0/14 tested benign patients (Fisher's exact p = 0.041; Firth OR 16.8, 95% profile-likelihood CI 1.6-2301.9), but this analysis was affected by verification bias (FDR q = 0.068). Six of 14 neoplastic lesions (42.9%) had none of the prespecified CT features. Two LAMN patients developed CT-documented peritoneal mucinous disease during follow-up; one had acellular peritoneal mucin already present at index resection. One patient with mucinous adenocarcinoma developed hepatic and peritoneal relapse at 14 months and subsequently died. No 30-day mortality occurred.
CONCLUSIONS: In this exploratory single-centre cohort, older age and selected CT features were associated with neoplastic AM. The composite criterion of ≥ 2 CT features showed high specificity (95.0%) but limited sensitivity (57.1%), with a positive predictive value of 80.0%; therefore, a negative CT assessment cannot exclude neoplasia. Selective CEA testing was affected by verification bias and showed a wide uncertainty interval; it cannot be considered a validated preoperative biomarker. The findings support heightened operative caution and structured preoperative assessment but should not be interpreted as a validated diagnostic rule or as an independent determinant of the extent of resection. Prospective multicentre validation is required.

turk.baslik: Clinical findings of thoracic injuries in forensic trauma and their importance in medico-legal evaluation.
turk.baslik_tr: Adli Travmada Torasik Yaralanmaların Klinik Bulguları ve Mediko-Legal Önemi
turk.kisa_ozet: İkinci basamak hastaneye başvuran 254 travmatik torasik yaralanmalı hastanın incelendiği çalışmada vakaların %86,2'si künt travma olup mortalite oranı %6,7 bulundu. Olguların %83,1'inde kemik kırığı ve %79,9'unda yaşamı tehdit edici durum saptandı.
turk.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Trauma remains one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Thoracic injuries constitute a frequently encountered group of injuries, particularly among young adult trauma patients. This study aimed to examine thoracic trauma of forensic relevance from a medico-legal perspective and to determine the demographic characteristics, clinical findings, and the relationship of these findings with forensic reporting.
METHODS: A total of 254 patients presenting with traumatic thoracic injuries to a secondary care hospital between 2023 and 2025 were retrospectively analyzed. The patients' age, sex, origin of the incident, clinical characteristics, and medico-legal outcomes were evaluated.
RESULTS: Of the cases, 75.2% were male, and the mean age was 48 years. Blunt trauma accounted for 86.2% of injuries, with in-vehicle road traffic accidents representing the most common cause (49.2%). According to current Turkish medico-legal guidelines, all cases were classified as injuries that could not be treated with simple medical intervention; 83.1% involved bone fractures, and 79.9% were considered life-threatening. Rib fractures were identified in 70.5% of cases, whereas intrathoracic injuries were detected in 71.3%. The most frequently observed pathologies were pneumothorax (70.2%) and hemothorax (50.8%). The frequencies of pneumothorax and hemothorax were significantly increased in cases of assault-related injury (p<0.05), whereas parenchymal contusion was more frequently observed in accidental injuries. The mortality rate was 6.7%.
CONCLUSION: Although thoracic trauma is relatively uncommon in secondary healthcare institutions, it carries a high risk of life-threatening complications and the potential for complex medico-legal consequences. Standardized and detailed medical documentation is essential to ensure consistency in legal processes and criminal sanctions. Focusing medico-legal evaluations not only on the trauma mechanism but also on anatomical injury and associated complications may improve the standardization and objectivity of forensic reports.

tez.baslik: Akut mezenter iskemili hastalarda risk faktörü olarak COVİD-19 enfeksiyonunun literatür eşliğinde değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Akut Mezenter İskemili Hastalarda Risk Faktörü Olarak COVID-19 Enfeksiyonu
tez.kisa_ozet: Elli sekiz hastanın incelendiği retrospektif gözlemsel çalışmada en sık mezenter iskemi tipi SMA (%62,1) olarak saptandı. COVID-19 pozitif hastalarda uç tip iskemi oranı daha yüksek bulunurken genel mortalite oranı %36,4 olarak gerçekleşti.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmada, akut mezenter iskemi (AMİ) tanısı alan hastalarda COVID-19 tanısı almış olmanın klinik özellikler, mezenter iskemi alt tipleri, tedavi yaklaşımları ve klinik sonuçlar üzerindeki etkisinin değerlendirilmesi amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu retrospektif ve gözlemsel çalışmaya, 01.04.2020–30.09.2025 tarihleri arasında Manisa Celal Bayar Üniversitesi Hastanesi Genel Cerrahi Kliniği'nde AMİ tanısı ile takip edilen 58 hasta dahil edildi. Hastalar COVID-19 tanısı almış olmalarına göre gruplandırıldı. Demografik veriler, komorbiditeler, mezenter iskemi alt tipleri, tedavi yöntemleri ve klinik sonuçlar analiz edildi. İstatistiksel analizlerde kategorik değişkenler için Fisher's exact ve Fisher-Freeman-Halton testleri, sürekli değişkenler için Mann-Whitney U ve Kruskal-Wallis testleri kullanıldı. Bulgular: Hastaların yaş ortalaması 68,52±13,83 yıl olup, en sık mezenter iskemi tipi SMA (%62,1) olarak saptandı. COVID-19 tanısı almış olanlar %20,7 oranında mevcuttu. COVID-19 tanısı almış hastalar ile mezenter iskemi alt tipleri arasında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı ilişki bulundu (p=0,021). COVID-19 pozitif hastalarda uç tip iskemi oranının daha yüksek olduğu görüldü. COVID-19 tanısı almış hastalar ile operasyon durumu (p=0,059), tedavi yöntemi (p=0,098), kardiyak yandaş hastalık (p=1,000) ve mortalite (p=0,360) arasında anlamlı ilişki saptanmadı. Genel mortalite oranı %36,4 olarak bulundu. Sonuçlar: COVID-19 tanısı, akut mezenter iskemi hastalarında mortalite ve tedavi yöntemleri üzerinde anlamlı bir etki göstermemekle birlikte, mezenter iskemi alt tiplerinin dağılımını anlamlı şekilde etkilemektedir. Bu bulgu, COVID-19'un AMİ patofizyolojisini farklı mekanizmalar üzerinden etkileyebileceğini düşündürmektedir. AMİ'de erken tanı ve hızlı tedavi yaklaşımı mortalitenin azaltılmasında temel belirleyici olmaya devam etmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Akut mezenter iskemi, COVID-19, mortalite, tromboz, cerrahi tedavi
